/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
  Evaluating a rule over a trace, and checking it before any trace.

  `verdicts` combines the binder classes, the applicability and the obligation per instant
  (Kleene, `verdictAt`). `check` finds from the syntax every defect the evaluator would otherwise
  report as `malformed` or `unboundVariable`; its doc comment lists them. `checkReading`
  names the parameters and aggregates the reading lacks, over the rule and the rules it composes,
  with their concept calls expanded; `Concept.checkReading` the aggregates a concept's body names.

  `Concept.check` holds a concept to the same standard on every admissible instantiation of
  its formals, with its calls expanded. `Concept.callDefects` holds every concept call to the
  callee's signature before expansion loses it.

  Nothing under Rules/ or Concepts/ imports this file; Grounding, Manifest and Monitor do.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.EvalFast

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Rule
open Semantics

/-- A rule's formula as evaluated: every comparison over a `cond` decided by cases, through the
    sub-expression cache (`evalFastAll`, whose every stored value is the one `evalAll` gives). -/
def evalRuleFormula (c : SemCtx) (φ : Formula) : Array R := evalFastAll c (Formula.elimCond φ)

/-- Every binder's class holds for its bound track and the applicability holds, per instant. -/
def engagedAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  Temporal.allOf c.n (r.binders.map (fun b => evalRuleFormula c b.cls) ++ [evalRuleFormula c r.applicability])

/-- The verdict at every instant. -/
def verdicts (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array Verdict :=
  Array.zipWith verdictAt (r.engagedAll c) (evalRuleFormula c r.obligation)

/-- The rule as a three-valued statement per instant: complied with (true), violated (false), or
    unknown. Not engaged counts as complied with — a rule that does not apply is not broken. -/
def asRAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  (r.verdicts c).map fun v => match v with
    | .compliant | .notApplicable => R.t
    | .violated => R.f
    | .unknown w => ⟨.u, w⟩

/-- Structural well-formedness apart from having a binder: binders named and distinct, the id
    set, every assumption and intention used declared, every intention id well-formed, every
    operationalization bounding its standard by atoms, primitives or concepts. -/
def wellFormedBody (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  r.binderNames.eraseDups.length == r.binders.length &&
  r.binders.all (fun b => !b.name.isEmpty) &&
  !r.id.isEmpty &&
  r.usedAssumptions.all (r.assumptions.contains ·) &&
  r.usedIntentions.all (r.intentions.contains ·) &&
  r.intentions.all IntId.wellFormed &&
  r.operationalizations.all (fun o => !o.concepts.isEmpty && o.concepts.all fun c =>
    c.startsWith "drv." || Primitives.primitiveNames.contains (defName c) || knowsAtom (defName c))

/-- Structural well-formedness: at least one binder, and `wellFormedBody`. -/
def wellFormed (r : Rule) : Bool := !r.binders.isEmpty && r.wellFormedBody

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Static check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Variables in scope with their sorts, the innermost first. -/
abbrev Scope := List (String × EntityKind)

/-- Whether `v` is bound and its innermost binding has sort `k`, as evaluation's lookup reads it. -/
def Scope.binds (scope : Scope) (v : String) (k : EntityKind) : Bool :=
  (scope.find? (·.1 == v)).map (·.2) == some k

/-- Resolve arguments against the scope with dummy ids, checking each variable's sort against the
    position's expected sort when the table knows it. An entity position takes a variable only:
    a literal or a number there would name a track, region or device the rule has no right to. -/
private def dummyArgs (scope : Scope) (sorts : Option (List (Option EntityKind))) (args : List Arg)
    : Except String (List Primitives.DArg) :=
  (args.zip (List.range args.length)).mapM fun (a, k) =>
    match a with
    | .var v =>
      match scope.find? (·.1 == v) with
      | none => .error s!"variable `{v}` is not bound"
      | some (_, vs) =>
        match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
        | some (some want) => if want == vs then .ok (.v 0) else .error s!"variable `{v}` has sort {repr vs}, position {k} wants {repr want}"
        | some none => .error s!"variable `{v}` where position {k} takes a literal"
        | none => .ok (.v 0)
    | .lit l =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"literal `{l}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.s l)
    | .nat n =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"number `{n}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.n n)

private def isMalformed : UnknownReason → Option String
  | .malformed w => some w
  | .parameterMissing w => some w
  | _ => none

private def emptyScene : Scene := { t := 0 }
private def emptyCtx : Primitives.Ctx := { scenes := #[], times := #[], ρ := {} }

/-- A quantifier's kind: a spelling the codec decodes. A variable is a concept's literal formal
    that reached the check unfilled. -/
private def kindErrors (where_ : String) (a : Arg) (what : String) (known : String → Bool) : List String :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => if known s then [] else [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{s}` names no kind"]
  | .var v => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{v}` is a variable; spell the kind, or fill it from a literal formal"]
  | .nat _ => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind is a number"]

private def constParamErrors (where_ name : String) (ps : List Term) : List String :=
  ps.filter (!Term.isConstant ·) |>.map fun _ => s!"{where_}: `{name}` parameter is not a constant term"

/-- A heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, a literal strictly positive. -/
private def stepErrors (where_ : String) : Term → List String
  | .lit q _ => if Q.lt Q.zero q then [] else [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not strictly positive"]
  | .param _ => []
  | _ => [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter"]

mutual
  partial def checkTerm (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .measure a args =>
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts a) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"]
      | .ok ds => match evalMeasure emptyScene a ds with
        | .error w => match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: measure `{a}`: {m}"] | none => []
        | .ok _ => []
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalQ concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .sinceRise φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      stepErrors where_ g ++ checkTerm scope where_ g ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ checkTerm ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => checkTerm scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b

  partial def checkFormula (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .tt | .ff | .asm _ => []
    | .intent _ who target =>
      [(who, EntityKind.track, "road user"), (target, EntityKind.region, "region")].flatMap fun (a, want, what) =>
        match a with
        | .var v => if scope.binds v want then [] else [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} `{v}` is not a bound {repr want}"]
        | _ => [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} is a variable"]
    | .same a b => [a, b].flatMap fun arg => match arg with
      | .var v => if scope.any (·.1 == v) then [] else [s!"{where_}: variable `{v}` is not bound"]
      | _ => [s!"{where_}: `same` compares two bound variables"]
    | .atom name args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ name ps
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts name) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds =>
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then inner     -- membership is the reading's; `checkReading` holds the word
        else match evalAtomE emptyScene name ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: atom `{name}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .cmp l _ r => checkTerm scope where_ l ++ checkTerm scope where_ r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ | .within m d subj φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => checkFormula scope where_ e ++ checkFormula scope where_ sφ
    | .rises φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .definedWhen p φ => checkFormula scope where_ p ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalB concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .rule _ map | .ruleApplies _ map => map.flatMap fun (_, outer) =>
        if scope.binds outer .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: composition maps to `{outer}`, not a bound track"]
    | .existsRegion k v φ | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "region" (fun s => (StructureKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsDevice k v φ | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "device" (fun s => (DeviceKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ

  partial def windowErrors (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subj : String) : List String :=
    (if m = .path && !scope.binds subj .track then [s!"{where_}: window subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"] else []) ++
    (if Term.isConstant d then [] else [s!"{where_}: window length is not a constant term"])
end

-- A declared intention read ahead of the judged observation: an `intent` leaf, or a composed
-- rule that reads one, within the scope of a future operator, in a formula or a term.
mutual
  partial def futureTerm (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Term → List String
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => futureTerm reads fut g ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
    | .neg a | .abs a => futureTerm reads fut a
    | .cond φ a b => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
    | _ => []
  partial def futureReads (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Formula → List String
    | .intent id _ _ => if fut then [s!"declared intention `{id}` is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
      if fut && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads a declared intention and is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
    | .cmp l _ r => futureTerm reads fut l ++ futureTerm reads fut r
    | .always φ | .eventually φ => futureReads reads true φ
    | .until φ ψ => futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
    | .within _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
    | .not φ | .rises φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut φ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut ψ ++ futureReads reads fut φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => futureReads reads fut e ++ futureReads reads fut sφ
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | _ => []
end

-- The distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`), whose zero is the start of the
-- recording, read where it can decide a search into the past: inside an operand of `since`, of
-- `atLast` or of `count`, inside the formula of `sinceRise`, the onset of `headingSince` or the
-- formula of `rises`, directly or through a composed rule that reads it. Everywhere else it is
-- ordinary arithmetic; path windows and `distanceWhile` measure differences and are never this.
mutual
  partial def pathTerm (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Term → List String
    | .measure "kin_path_length" _ =>
      if back then ["the distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`) is read inside a search into the past (`since`, `sinceRise`, `atLast`, `count` or `rises`); the start of a recording is no event of a road user's history"] else []
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | .sinceRise φ => pathReads reads true φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => pathTerm reads back g ++ pathReads reads true ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
    | .neg a | .abs a => pathTerm reads back a
    | .cond φ a b => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
    | _ => []
  partial def pathReads (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Formula → List String
    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
      if back && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads the distance travelled since the trace began and is composed inside a search into the past"] else []
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
    | .cmp l _ r => pathTerm reads back l ++ pathTerm reads back r
    | .since φ ψ => pathReads reads true φ ++ pathReads reads true ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads true ψ ++ pathReads reads true φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => pathReads reads true e ++ pathReads reads true sφ
    | .rises φ => pathReads reads true φ
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- Whether a rule, or a rule it composes, reads `kin_path_length` anywhere. -/
def readsPath (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  (closure rules r).any fun x => x.formulas.any fun φ => !(pathReads (fun _ => false) true φ).isEmpty

/-- Every defect a rule has before any trace; empty for a rule the evaluator will never report
    `malformed` or `unboundVariable` on: an empty id; no binder, or one unnamed or named twice;
    an assumption or intention read but not declared, or an intention id ill-formed; an
    operationalization bounded by nothing, or by a name that is no atom, primitive or concept; a
    name no table knows; an atom, measure, primitive or concept given the wrong number of
    arguments; an unbound variable, or one of the wrong sort where a track, region or device is
    read (such a position takes a variable, never a spelling or a number; a literal position
    takes no variable); a spelling no enumeration decodes; a quantifier kind that is not a
    spelling; a parameter of an atom or a call, or a window's length, that is not a constant
    term (a literal, a reading parameter, or arithmetic over them); a heading change's step bound
    that is not a literal or a reading parameter, or a literal one not strictly positive; a
    declared intention read ahead of the judged observation; the distance travelled since the trace began read inside a
    search into the past; a composed rule not in the set, or a map that names a variable not
    bound to a track, misses one of its binders or names one it does not have. `regions` names
    variables the caller binds to regions: the region formals of a concept's instance, which
    alone may then have no binder. -/
def check (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (regions : List String := []) : List String :=
  let scope : Scope := r.binderNames.map (fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)) ++ regions.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.region)
  let formed := if regions.isEmpty then r.wellFormed else r.wellFormedBody
  let reads (id : String) : Bool := match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | some r' => r'.readsIntention rules
    | none => false
  (if formed then [] else [s!"{r.id}: binders empty, duplicated or unnamed, an assumption, intention or concept undeclared, or an intention id ill-formed"]) ++
  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => checkFormula [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap (futureReads reads false) |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap (pathReads (fun id => (rules.find? (·.id == id)).any (readsPath rules)) false)
    |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.compositions).flatMap (fun (id, map) =>
    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | none => [s!"{r.id}: composes unknown rule `{id}`"]
    | some r' =>
      (map.filter (fun (inner, _) => !r'.binderNames.contains inner) |>.map fun (inner, _) => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` maps `{inner}`, not one of its binders") ++
      (r'.binderNames.filter (fun b => !map.any (·.1 == b)) |>.map fun b => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` leaves its binder `{b}` unmapped"))

/-- The aggregate ids `who` names that the reading does not declare, or whose declaration lists
    an id that is no road-user class. -/
def aggregateDefects (who : String) (ids : List String) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
  ids.eraseDups.flatMap fun w =>
    match ρ.aggregate w with
    | none => [s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` is not declared by the reading"]
    | some a => (a.included ++ a.unresolved).filter (fun id => !id.startsWith "ru." || (RoadUserClass.ofString (id.drop 3).toString).isNone)
        |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` lists `{id}`, which is not a road-user class"

/-- Parameters and aggregates that the rule, or a rule it composes, names and the reading lacks,
    each rule read with its calls of the concepts `cs` expanded. -/
def checkReading (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (ρ : Reading) (cs : List Concept := []) : List String :=
  (Rule.closure rules r).flatMap fun x =>
    let xx := Concept.expandRule cs x
    (xx.params.filter (!ρ.has ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{x.id}: parameter `{p}` is not in the reading")
    ++ aggregateDefects x.id (xx.formulas.flatMap Formula.aggregateIds) ρ

end Rule

/-- Rule composition over a library, with fuel bounding the nesting depth. The composed rule's
    binders are bound through `map` (inner binder ↦ caller variable); an unmapped binder is an
    unbound variable, an unknown id is `compositionUnknown`. `engaged` selects the composed
    rule's applicability (for an exception or a condition) over its compliance. -/
def composeWith (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) :
    Nat → String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R
  | 0, id, _, _, _ => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
  | fuel + 1, id, map, β, engaged =>
    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | none => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
    | some r =>
      let β' : Binding := ⟨map.filterMap fun (inner, outer) => (β.lookup outer).map fun v => (inner, v)⟩
      let c : Semantics.SemCtx := { d := d, β := β', compose := composeWith rules d fuel }
      if engaged then r.engagedAll c else r.asRAll c

/-- The evaluation context for a rule set over an indexed trace: composition resolves against
    `rules`, nested at most `rules.length` deep. -/
def Rule.context (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) (β : Binding) : Semantics.SemCtx :=
  { d := d, β := β, compose := composeWith rules d rules.length }

namespace Concept
open Semantics

-- Every concept call against the callee's signature: a track formal takes a variable bound to a
-- track, a region formal one bound to a region, a literal formal one of its admissible values, a
-- nat formal a number. Run on formulas whose own literal and nat formals already hold values.
mutual
  partial def termCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .quantity n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .measure _ _ | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ g ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
  partial def callDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .derived n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .cmp l _ r => termCallDefects cs scope where_ l ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ | .count φ ψ _ _ =>
      callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ | .atLast _ d _ φ ψ =>
      termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsRegion _ v φ | .forallRegion _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsDevice _ v φ | .forallDevice _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
    | _ => []
  partial def callArgs (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ name : String) (args : List Arg) : List String :=
    match cs.find? (·.leanName == name) with
    | none => []
    | some c =>
      if args.length != c.args.length then []        -- an arity the expansion leaves for `Rule.check` to report
      else (c.args.zip args).filterMap fun ((n, so), a) =>
        let bad := some s!"{where_}: `{c.id}` formal `{n}` ({repr so}) is given {repr a}"
        match so, a with
        | .track, .var v => if scope.binds v .track then none else bad
        | .region, .var v => if scope.binds v .region then none else bad
        | .literal vs, .lit l => if vs.contains l then none else bad
        | .nat, .nat _ => none
        | _, _ => bad
end

/-- `callDefects` on a rule before expansion: each binder's class with that binder, the
    applicability and the obligation with every binder, all as tracks. -/
def ruleCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : List String :=
  let scope : Rule.Scope := r.binderNames.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)
  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => callDefects cs [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation


/-- Every defect a concept has before any trace: an empty id; a formal or a parameter named
    twice; a parameter named as a reading's, or a body parameter that is no formal parameter; a
    literal formal that admits no value; a composed rule or a declared intention in the body (a
    concept reads neither); a referenced concept unknown, or a reference cycle; and, on every
    admissible instantiation of its literal formals with its calls expanded, every defect
    `Rule.check` finds in a formula and a call whose arguments do not fit the callee's formals. -/
def check (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) : List String :=
  let names := c.args.map (·.1)
  let pnames := c.paramNames
  let body := c.bodyFormula
  let structural :=
    (if c.id.isEmpty then ["concept: empty id"] else []) ++
    (if names.eraseDups.length != names.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal argument"] else []) ++
    (if pnames.eraseDups.length != pnames.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal parameter"] else []) ++
    (pnames.filter (·.contains '.') |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: parameter `{p}` names a reading parameter; a body references its formals only") ++
    (c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
      | .literal [] => some s!"{c.id}: literal formal `{n}` admits no value"
      | _ => none) ++
    ((Formula.params body).eraseDups.filter (!pnames.contains ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: `{p}` is not a formal parameter") ++
    ((Formula.composed body).map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept composes no rule (`{id}`)") ++
    ((Formula.intentions body).eraseDups.map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept reads no declared intention (`{id}`)") ++
    (c.refs.filter (fun n => !cs.any (·.leanName == n))
      |>.map fun n => s!"{c.id}: references unknown concept `{n}`") ++
    (if (onCycle cs).contains c.id then [s!"{c.id}: on a reference cycle"] else [])
  let scope : Rule.Scope := c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
    | .track => some (n, EntityKind.track)
    | .region => some (n, EntityKind.region)
    | _ => none
  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
  let byInstance := (samples c).flatMap fun args =>
    match instantiate c args ps "check" with
    | none => [s!"{c.id}: arity"]
    | some b =>
      let φ := match b with | .formula φ => φ | .quantity t => Formula.cmp t .eq t
      let φx := expand cs φ
      callDefects cs scope c.id φ ++ Rule.checkFormula scope c.id φx ++
        (Rule.pathReads (fun _ => false) false φx).map fun e => s!"{c.id}: {e}"
  structural ++ byInstance.eraseDups

/-- The aggregates a concept's body names, its calls expanded, that the reading does not declare
    or declares with an id that is no road-user class. -/
def checkReading (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
  Rule.aggregateDefects c.id (aggregateIds cs c) ρ

end Concept

end TrafficSpec

1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
3	  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
4	  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
5	  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
6	  a formula or a road user is.
7	
8	  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
9	  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
10	  on a witness, false only when covered.
11	-/
12	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
13	import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown
14	
15	namespace TrafficSpec
16	namespace Temporal
17	
18	def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
19	def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)
20	
21	-- pointwise connectives
22	def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
23	def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
24	def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
25	def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
26	def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
27	def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)
28	
29	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
30	-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
31	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
33	  let n := vals.size
34	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
35	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
36	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1
37	
38	private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
39	  let n := vals.size
40	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
41	    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
42	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1
43	
44	/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
45	def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
46	/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
47	def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
48	/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
49	def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
50	  let n := ψ.size
51	  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
52	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
53	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
54	/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
55	def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
56	  let n := ψ.size
57	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
58	    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
59	    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
60	/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
61	def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
62	/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
63	def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
64	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!
65	
66	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
68	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
69	/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
70	    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
71	    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
72	    adequately sampled. -/
73	def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
74	  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
75	  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
76	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
77	    match wins[i]! with
78	    | none => R.u missing
79	    | some w =>
80	      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
81	      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
82	      else agg.all w.j0 i
83	
84	/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
85	    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
86	private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
87	  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
88	    match acc with
89	    | some r => some r
90	    | none =>
91	      let j := i - k
92	      match ψ[j]!.v with
93	      | .t => some φ[j]!
94	      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
95	      | .f => none) none
96	
97	/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
98	    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
99	    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
100	    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
101	    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
102	def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
103	  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
104	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
105	    match wins[i]! with
106	    | none => R.u missing
107	    | some w =>
108	      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
109	      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
110	      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f
111	
112	/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
113	    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
114	def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
115	  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
116	  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
117	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
118	    match wins[i]! with
119	    | none => R.u missing
120	    | some w =>
121	      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
122	      else
123	        let a := agg.any i w.jl
124	        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)
125	
126	/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
127	def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
128	  let n := vals.size
129	  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
130	    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
131	
132	/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
133	    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
134	    already failed. -/
135	def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
136	  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
137	  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
138	  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
139	  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
140	  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
141	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
142	    match wins[i]! with
143	    | none => R.u missing
144	    | some w =>
145	      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
146	      else
147	        let b := firstψ[i]!
148	        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
149	        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
150	        let witnessed : R :=
151	          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
152	          else
153	            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
154	            let a := firstφf[i]!
155	            let hi := min a w.jl
156	            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
157	            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
158	            else
159	              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
160	                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
161	              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
162	        if w.covered then witnessed
163	        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))
164	
165	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
166	-- Runs and counts
167	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
168	/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
169	    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
170	    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
171	    begun before the recording). -/
172	def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
173	  let n := vals.size
174	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
175	    let v := vals[i]!
176	    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
177	      match v.v with
178	      | .t =>
179	        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
180	        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
181	          | .t => acc.2
182	          | .f => .ok (some i)
183	          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
184	      | .f => acc.2
185	      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
186	    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1
187	
188	/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
189	    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
190	    reaches the trace start. -/
191	def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
192	  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
193	  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
194	    match holds[i]!.v with
195	    | .f => .ok Q.zero
196	    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
197	    | .t =>
198	      match starts[i]! with
199	      | .error e => .error e
200	      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
201	      | .ok (some j) =>
202	        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
203	        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
204	        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")
205	
206	/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
207	def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
208	  let n := edge.size
209	  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
210	  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
211	  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
212	    if k = 0 then .ok false
213	    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
214	      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
215	      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
216	      | .t, .f => .ok true
217	      | _, _ => .ok false
218	  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
219	    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
220	  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
221	    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
222	  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
223	    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
224	  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
225	    match starts[i]! with
226	    | .error e => .error e
227	    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
228	    | .ok (some j) =>
229	      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
230	      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
231	        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
232	      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)
233	
234	/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
235	    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
236	    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
237	    before the first observation among them. -/
238	def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
239	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
240	    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))
241	
242	/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
243	    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
244	def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
245	  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
246	  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
247	    match starts[i]! with
248	    | .error e => .error e
249	    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
250	    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)
251	
252	/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
253	    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
254	def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
255	  let n := vals.size
256	  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
257	    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
258	      match acc.2 with
259	      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
260	      | .error e => .error e
261	      | .ok none =>
262	        match vals[i]!.v with
263	        | .t => .ok (some i)
264	        | .f => .ok none
265	        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
266	    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1
267	
268	
269	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
270	-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
271	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
272	section Lengths
273	
274	/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
275	theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
276	    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
277	    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
278	  induction l generalizing init with
279	  | nil => rfl
280	  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]
281	
282	theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
283	theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
284	theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
285	theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
286	theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]
287	
288	private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
289	    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
290	  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
291	
292	private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
293	    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
294	  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
295	
296	theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
297	theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
298	theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
299	theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
300	  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
301	theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
302	  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
303	theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
304	theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
305	    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
306	theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
307	    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
308	theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
309	    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
310	theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
311	    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
312	theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
313	    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
314	theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
315	    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
316	theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
317	theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
318	  simp [sinceRiseAll]
319	
320	end Lengths
321	
322	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
323	-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
324	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
325	section HoldsFor
326	
327	theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
328	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
329	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
330	      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
331	      | none => R.u missing
332	      | some w =>
333	        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
334	        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
335	        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
336	  unfold holdsForAll
337	  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
338	  simp
339	
340	/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
341	    the result false. -/
342	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
343	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
344	    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
345	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
346	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
347	  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]
348	
349	/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
350	    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
351	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
352	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
353	    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
354	    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
355	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
356	  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
357	    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
358	    hn j h1 h2 h3
359	  simp [hc, this]
360	
361	/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
362	theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
363	    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
364	    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
365	    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by
366	  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw] at hf
367	  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
368	  split at hf
369	  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
370	    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
371	  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf
372	
373	end HoldsFor
374	
375	end Temporal
376	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Temporal
  The temporal operators over a whole trace at once: every operator maps per-instant arrays to a
  per-instant array in one pass (or one pass plus O(1) window queries), so a formula costs
  O(|φ| · n log n) per grounding. Semantics and Derived both use these; nothing here knows what
  a formula or a road user is.

  Finite-trace policy: the unobserved past and future are unknown (`windowTruncated`), never a
  verdict. A lookback window must be covered and adequately sampled; a lookahead window is true
  on a witness, false only when covered.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Time
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Temporal

def const (n : Nat) (r : R) : Array R := Array.replicate n r
def truncated (op : String) : R := R.u (.windowTruncated op)

-- pointwise connectives
def zipAnd (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.and a b
def zipOr (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.or a b
def zipImplies (a b : Array R) : Array R := Array.zipWith R.implies a b
def mapNot (a : Array R) : Array R := a.map R.not
def allOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipAnd (const n R.t)
def anyOf (n : Nat) (xs : List (Array R)) : Array R := xs.foldl zipOr (const n R.f)

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Unbounded operators: one backward or forward pass with the unobserved tail as unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
private def backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n tail, tail)).1

private def forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := step vals[i]! acc.2
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n head, head)).1

/-- `always φ`: φ here and at every later observation, and the unobserved future. -/
def alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "always") R.and φ
/-- `eventually φ`: φ here or later, or the unobserved future. -/
def eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := backward (truncated "eventually") R.or φ
/-- Strong until: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ until')`, the unobserved future as the tail. -/
def untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "until"), truncated "until")).1
/-- Since: `ψ ∨ (φ ∧ since')`, the unobserved past as the head. -/
def sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let n := ψ.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array R × R) i =>
    let r := R.or ψ[i]! (R.and φ[i]! acc.2)
    (acc.1.set! i r, r)) (Array.replicate n (truncated "since"), truncated "since")).1
/-- `once φ`: φ here or at some earlier observation, or the unobserved past. -/
def onceAll (φ : Array R) : Array R := forward (truncated "once") (fun v acc => R.or v acc) φ
/-- φ at the previous observation (`first` at the trace start). -/
def prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i => if i = 0 then first else φ[i - 1]!

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Metric windows: positions per instant (time or path), a length d, per-instant values.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- φ at every observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant. Unknown where a
    position inside the window is missing; where the window is not covered, false on a false
    already observed inside it and unknown otherwise; unknown where it is covered but not
    adequately sampled. -/
def holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.covered then (if (agg.all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
      else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else agg.all w.j0 i

/-- The value of φ at the latest observation `j` in `[j0, i]` at which ψ held: unknown where ψ is
    unknown at an observation later than any at which it held; none where ψ held nowhere in the range. -/
private def atLastAt (ψ φ : Array R) (j0 i : Nat) : Option R :=
  (List.range (i + 1 - j0)).foldl (fun (acc : Option R) k =>
    match acc with
    | some r => some r
    | none =>
      let j := i - k
      match ψ[j]!.v with
      | .t => some φ[j]!
      | .u => some ⟨.u, ψ[j]!.why⟩
      | .f => none) none

/-- φ at the last observation in the window of length `d` behind each instant at which ψ held.
    Unknown where a position is missing, where ψ is unknown later than any observation at which it
    held, where the window is not adequately sampled (an unobserved later instant could be the last
    one at which ψ held), and where ψ held nowhere in a window that is not covered; false where ψ
    held nowhere in a covered, adequately sampled window. -/
def atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.backWindows pos d
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      match atLastAt ψ φ w.j0 i with
      | some r => if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else r
      | none => if !w.covered then truncated op else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op) else R.f

/-- φ at some observation in the window of length `d` ahead: true on a witness, false only when
    the window is covered, unknown when it runs off the trace. -/
def withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let agg := RangeAgg.build φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let a := agg.any i w.jl
        if w.covered then a else R.or a (truncated op)

/-- Smallest `k ≥ i` whose value satisfies `p` (size when none), per instant. -/
def nextWhere (vals : Array R) (p : Tri → Bool) : Array Nat :=
  let n := vals.size
  (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
    acc.set! i (if p vals[i]!.v then i else acc[i + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)

/-- Strong until restricted to the window ahead: ∃ j in the window, ψ at j and φ at every
    observation from here to just before j; the unobserved remainder counts as unknown unless φ
    already failed. -/
def untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) : Array R :=
  let wins := Time.forwardWindows pos d
  let aggφ := RangeAgg.build φ
  let aggψ := RangeAgg.build ψ
  let firstψ := nextWhere ψ (· = .t)
  let firstφf := nextWhere φ (· = .f)
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match wins[i]! with
    | none => R.u missing
    | some w =>
      if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
      else
        let b := firstψ[i]!
        -- φ at every observation from i up to, not including, b (empty when b = i)
        let φBefore (b : Nat) : R := if b ≤ i then R.t else aggφ.all i (b - 1)
        let witnessed : R :=
          if b ≤ w.jl && (φBefore b).v = .t then R.t
          else
            -- false only if every candidate fails: ψ false up to the first φ failure (or the window end)
            let a := firstφf[i]!
            let hi := min a w.jl
            let ψany := aggψ.any i hi
            if ψany.v = .f then R.f
            else
              let why := (if ψany.v = .u then ψany.why else []) ++
                (if b ≤ w.jl then (φBefore b).why else [])
              ⟨.u, if why.isEmpty then [.windowTruncated op] else why⟩
        if w.covered then witnessed
        else R.or witnessed (R.and (truncated op) (aggφ.all i w.jl))

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Runs and counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- The first instant of the latest run of true values ending at the latest true instant ≤ i:
    "since φ became true". `none` before any true; an error where an unknown value hides the
    run's start, and `windowTruncated op` where the run reaches the trace start (it may have
    begun before the recording). -/
def runStartAll (op : String) (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let v := vals[i]!
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match v.v with
      | .t =>
        if i = 0 then .error (.windowTruncated op)
        else match vals[i - 1]!.v with
          | .t => acc.2
          | .f => .ok (some i)
          | .u => .error (vals[i - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
      | .f => acc.2
      | .u => .error (v.why.head?.getD (.malformed op))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1

/-- Path length over which `holds` has held continuously up to each instant: zero where it does
    not hold, unknown where it is unknown, where the path length is missing, or where the run
    reaches the trace start. -/
def distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "distance_while" holds
  (Array.range holds.size).map fun i =>
    match holds[i]!.v with
    | .f => .ok Q.zero
    | .u => .error (holds[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "distance_while"))
    | .t =>
      match starts[i]! with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "distance_while")
      | .ok (some j) =>
        match pathPos[i]!, pathPos[j]! with
        | some pi, some pj => .ok (Q.sub pi pj)
        | _, _ => .error (.absentAtom "kin_path_length")

/-- Rising edges of `edge` since the start of the latest run of `sinceφ`, per instant. -/
def countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason Nat) :=
  let n := edge.size
  let starts := runStartAll op sinceφ
  -- edge k: true when edge[k] = t and edge[k-1] = f; unknown when either is unknown
  let edgeVal : Array (Except UnknownReason Bool) := (Array.range n).map fun k =>
    if k = 0 then .ok false
    else match edge[k]!.v, edge[k - 1]!.v with
      | .u, _ => .error (edge[k]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | _, .u => .error (edge[k - 1]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "count"))
      | .t, .f => .ok true
      | _, _ => .ok false
  let prefT := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .ok true => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let prefU := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.push (acc[k]! + (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => 1 | _ => 0))) #[0]
  let nextU := (List.range n).reverse.foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) k =>
    acc.set! k (match edgeVal[k]! with | .error _ => k | _ => acc[k + 1]!)) (Array.replicate (n + 1) n)
  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated op)
    | .ok (some j) =>
      -- edges at k ∈ (j, i]
      if prefU[i + 1]! - prefU[j + 1]! > 0 then
        match edgeVal[nextU[j + 1]!]! with | .error e => .error e | _ => .error (.malformed op)
      else .ok (prefT[i + 1]! - prefT[j + 1]!)

/-- φ here and not at the previous observation, as a three-valued conjunction: false where φ is
    false here, or true at the previous observation; true where φ is true here and false before;
    unknown otherwise, with the reasons of the values it could not settle, the unobserved past
    before the first observation among them. -/
def risesAll (φ : Array R) : Array R :=
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    R.and φ[i]! (R.not (if i = 0 then truncated "rises" else φ[i - 1]!))

/-- Seconds since φ last became true: from the start of the latest run of true values; unknown
    where that run reaches the trace start or none is observed. -/
def sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : Array QR :=
  let starts := runStartAll "since_rise" φ
  (Array.range φ.size).map fun i =>
    match starts[i]! with
    | .error e => .error e
    | .ok none => .error (.windowTruncated "since_rise")
    | .ok (some j) => .ok (Q.sub times[i]! times[j]!)

/-- First instant ≤ i at which `vals` is true; an error if an unknown precedes it. A first true at
    index 0 is an upper bound on the true onset, which the caller must treat as such. -/
def firstTrueAll (vals : Array R) : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) :=
  let n := vals.size
  ((List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array (Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) × Except UnknownReason (Option Nat)) i =>
    let st : Except UnknownReason (Option Nat) :=
      match acc.2 with
      | .ok (some j) => .ok (some j)
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok none =>
        match vals[i]!.v with
        | .t => .ok (some i)
        | .f => .ok none
        | .u => .error (vals[i]!.why.head?.getD (.malformed "first"))
    (acc.1.push st, st)) (Array.mkEmpty n, .ok none)).1


-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lengths: every operator returns one value per observation of the array it walks.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section Lengths

/-- A left fold whose step keeps the length of the array it carries keeps the initial length. -/
theorem size_foldl_carry {α β : Type} (l : List Nat) (f : Array α × β → Nat → Array α × β)
    (hf : ∀ acc i, (f acc i).1.size = acc.1.size) (init : Array α × β) :
    (l.foldl f init).1.size = init.1.size := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.foldl]; rw [ih, hf]

theorem size_const (n : Nat) (r : R) : (const n r).size = n := by simp [const]
theorem size_zipAnd (a b : Array R) : (zipAnd a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipAnd]
theorem size_zipOr (a b : Array R) : (zipOr a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipOr]
theorem size_zipImplies (a b : Array R) : (zipImplies a b).size = min a.size b.size := by simp [zipImplies]
theorem size_mapNot (a : Array R) : (mapNot a).size = a.size := by simp [mapNot]

private theorem size_backward (tail : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (backward tail step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold backward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

private theorem size_forward (head : R) (step : R → R → R) (vals : Array R) :
    (forward head step vals).size = vals.size := by
  unfold forward; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp

theorem size_alwaysAll (φ : Array R) : (alwaysAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_eventuallyAll (φ : Array R) : (eventuallyAll φ).size = φ.size := size_backward _ _ _
theorem size_onceAll (φ : Array R) : (onceAll φ).size = φ.size := size_forward _ _ _
theorem size_untilAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (untilAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold untilAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_sinceAll (φ ψ : Array R) : (sinceAll φ ψ).size = ψ.size := by
  unfold sinceAll; rw [size_foldl_carry] <;> simp
theorem size_prevAll (first : R) (φ : Array R) : (prevAll first φ).size = φ.size := by simp [prevAll]
theorem size_holdsForAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [holdsForAll]
theorem size_atLastAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (ψ φ : Array R) :
    (atLastAll pos d op w ψ φ).size = φ.size := by simp [atLastAll]
theorem size_withinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ : Array R) :
    (withinAll pos d op w φ).size = φ.size := by simp [withinAll]
theorem size_untilWithinAll (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (w : UnknownReason) (φ ψ : Array R) :
    (untilWithinAll pos d op w φ ψ).size = φ.size := by simp [untilWithinAll]
theorem size_distanceWhileAll (pathPos : Array (Option Q)) (holds : Array R) :
    (distanceWhileAll pathPos holds).size = holds.size := by simp [distanceWhileAll]
theorem size_countEdgesAll (op : String) (edge sinceφ : Array R) :
    (countEdgesAll op edge sinceφ).size = edge.size := by simp [countEdgesAll]
theorem size_risesAll (φ : Array R) : (risesAll φ).size = φ.size := by simp [risesAll]
theorem size_sinceRiseAll (times : Array Q) (φ : Array R) : (sinceRiseAll times φ).size = φ.size := by
  simp [sinceRiseAll]

end Lengths

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A window that reaches past the trace start: false only on an observed false, else unknown.
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
section HoldsFor

theorem holdsForAll_getElem! (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (hi : i < φ.size) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! =
      match (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! with
      | none => R.u missing
      | some w =>
        if !w.covered then (if ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v = .f then R.f else truncated op)
        else if !w.adequate then R.u (.samplingGap op)
        else (RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i := by
  unfold holdsForAll
  rw [getElem!_pos _ i (by simpa using hi)]
  simp

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered, a false observation `j` with `w.j0 ≤ j ≤ i` makes
    the result false. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (j : Nat) (hj0 : w.j0 ≤ j) (hji : j ≤ i) (hf : φ[j]!.v = .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = R.f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  simp [hc, RangeAgg.all_f_of_witness φ w.j0 i j hi hj0 hji hf, R.f]

/-- At an instant whose window is not covered and holds no false observation in `[w.j0, i]`, the
    result is the truncation, with its reason. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_of_no_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hn : ∀ j, w.j0 ≤ j → j ≤ i → φ[j]!.v ≠ .f) :
    (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]! = truncated op := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw]
  have : ((RangeAgg.build φ).all w.j0 i).v ≠ .f := fun hf =>
    let ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i hf
    hn j h1 h2 h3
  simp [hc, this]

/-- A false at an instant whose window is not covered has a false observation inside the window. -/
theorem holdsForAll_uncovered_f (pos : Array (Option Q)) (d : Q) (op : String) (missing : UnknownReason)
    (φ : Array R) (i : Nat) (w : Time.Back) (hi : i < φ.size) (hw : (Time.backWindows pos d)[i]! = some w)
    (hc : w.covered = false) (hf : (holdsForAll pos d op missing φ)[i]!.v = .f) :
    ∃ j, w.j0 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ i ∧ j < φ.size ∧ φ[j]!.v = .f := by
  rw [holdsForAll_getElem! pos d op missing φ i hi, hw] at hf
  simp only [hc, Bool.not_false, if_true] at hf
  split at hf
  · obtain ⟨j, h1, h2, _, h3⟩ := RangeAgg.all_f_witness φ w.j0 i ‹_›
    exact ⟨j, h1, h2, by omega, h3⟩
  · simp [truncated, R.u] at hf

end HoldsFor

end Temporal
end TrafficSpec

27	/-- Whether two boundaries are the same list of vertices, each coordinate compared by its
28	    numerator and denominator. -/
29	def sameBoundary : List Vec → List Vec → Bool
30	  | [], [] => true
31	  | a :: as, b :: bs =>
32	    a.1.num == b.1.num && a.1.den == b.1.den && a.2.num == b.2.num && a.2.den == b.2.den && sameBoundary as bs
33	  | _, _ => false
34	
35	theorem sameBoundary_eq : ∀ {a b : List Vec}, sameBoundary a b = true → a = b
36	  | [], [], _ => rfl
37	  | a :: as, b :: bs, h => by
38	    simp only [sameBoundary, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
39	    obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩ := h
40	    rcases a with ⟨⟨an1, ad1, _⟩, ⟨an2, ad2, _⟩⟩
41	    rcases b with ⟨⟨bn1, bd1, _⟩, ⟨bn2, bd2, _⟩⟩
42	    simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4
43	    subst h1 h2 h3 h4
44	    rw [sameBoundary_eq h5]
45	  | [], _ :: _, h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h
46	  | _ :: _, [], h => by simp [sameBoundary] at h

48	/-- A region's boundary with its simple-polygon flag, computed the first time it is read; the flag
49	    is the direct check of that boundary by construction. -/
50	structure SimpleEntry where
51	  id : RegionId
52	  boundary : List Vec
53	  flag : Thunk Bool
54	  ok : flag.get = Geom.simplePolygon boundary
55	
56	/-- One entry per region and distinct boundary in the trace: a map's boundaries do not change from
57	    scene to scene, so each is checked once however many scenes and calls read it. -/
58	def simpleTable (scenes : Array Scene) : List SimpleEntry :=
59	  scenes.foldl (fun acc s => s.structures.foldl (fun acc st =>
60	      match st.boundary with
61	      | none => acc
62	      | some b =>
63	        if acc.any (fun e => e.id == st.id && sameBoundary e.boundary b) then acc
64	        else ⟨st.id, b, Thunk.mk (fun _ => Geom.simplePolygon b), rfl⟩ :: acc) acc) []
65	
66	/-- The trace indexed for evaluation, with the run's reading. `aggregateOverrides` fixes the
67	    membership of a track in an aggregate to a value, for the sensitivity of a verdict to that
68	    membership; it is empty in every evaluation that judges a trace. -/
69	structure Ctx where
70	  scenes : Array Scene
71	  times : Array Q
72	  ρ : Reading
73	  aggregateOverrides : List (TrackId × String × Bool) := []
74	  /-- The simple-polygon flags of the trace's boundaries (`simpleIn`). -/
75	  simple : List SimpleEntry := simpleTable scenes
76	  /-- What a region quantifier reads of these scenes, built once and shared by every evaluation of
77	      this context (`RegionTable`). -/
78	  regions : RegionTable.Tables scenes := RegionTable.Tables.build scenes
79	
80	/-- Whether a region's boundary is a simple polygon, read from the trace's table when the region and
81	    its boundary are there, checked directly otherwise. -/
82	def simpleIn (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : Bool :=
83	  match c.simple.find? (fun e => e.id == r && sameBoundary e.boundary poly) with
84	  | some e => e.flag.get
85	  | none => Geom.simplePolygon poly

87	/-- The table never changes the answer: a hit is the direct check of the same boundary, a miss (a
88	    region or boundary not in the table, a boundary changed since) is the direct check. -/
89	theorem simpleIn_eq (c : Ctx) (r : RegionId) (poly : List Vec) : simpleIn c r poly = Geom.simplePolygon poly := by
90	  unfold simpleIn
91	  split
92	  · rename_i e h
93	    have hp := List.find?_some h
94	    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at hp
95	    rw [e.ok, sameBoundary_eq hp.2]
96	  · rfl

113	def each (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → R) : Array R := c.scenes.map f
114	def eachQ (c : Ctx) (f : Scene → QR) : Array QR := c.scenes.map f
115	def timePos (c : Ctx) : Array (Option Q) := c.times.map some

123	def qAtom (o : Option Q) (name : String) : QR :=

128	/-- Heading change (degrees, left positive) integrated over the back window of length w:
129	    prefix sums of yaw rate × interval, one window query per instant. -/
130	def yawChange (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array (Except UnknownReason Q) :=
131	  let n := c.n
132	  -- sums[i] = Σ_{k ≤ i} ω_k (t_k − t_{k−1}); a missing yaw rate contributes nothing and is tracked
133	  let sums := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Q) i =>
134	    let prev := if i = 0 then Q.zero else acc[i - 1]!
135	    let dt := if i = 0 then Q.zero else Q.sub c.times[i]! c.times[i - 1]!
136	    acc.push (match kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x with
137	      | some ω => Q.add prev (Q.mul ω dt)
138	      | none => prev)) #[]
139	  -- lastMissing[i] = latest index ≤ i with a missing yaw rate (n when none)
140	  let lastMissing := (List.range n).foldl (fun (acc : Array Nat) i =>
141	    acc.push (if (kin_yaw_rate c.scenes[i]! x).isNone then i else (if i = 0 then n else acc[i - 1]!))) #[]
142	  let wins := Time.backWindows (timePos c) w
143	  (Array.range n).map fun i =>
144	    match wins[i]! with
145	    | none => .error .outOfRange
146	    | some win =>
147	      if !win.covered then .error (.windowTruncated "prim_heading_change")
148	      else if !win.adequate then .error (.samplingGap "prim_heading_change")
149	      else
150	        let lm := lastMissing[i]!
151	        if lm ≠ n && lm > win.j0 then .error (.absentAtom "kin_yaw_rate")
152	        else .ok (Q.sub sums[i]! sums[win.j0]!)

157	/-- minute m of the day lies in the window [start, end), wrapping past midnight when end ≤ start. -/
158	def inWindow (w : TimeWindow) (m : Nat) : Bool :=
159	  if w.startMinute < w.endMinute then w.startMinute ≤ m && m < w.endMinute
160	  else m ≥ w.startMinute || m < w.endMinute

162	private def hasClassOpt (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) (k : RoadUserClass) : Option Bool :=
163	  (s.user x).bind fun u => if u.unobservedClasses.contains k then none else u.classes.map (·.contains k)

168	/-- Under constant velocities, the time of closest approach of the two centres and the centre
169	    distance then; `none` when the paths do not approach within `[0, horizon]`. -/
170	private def closestApproach (s : Scene) (a b : TrackId) (horizon : Q) : Except UnknownReason (Option (Q × Q)) := do
171	  let pa ← vecAtom (kin_position s a) "kin_position"
172	  let pb ← vecAtom (kin_position s b) "kin_position"
173	  let va ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s a) "kin_velocity"
174	  let vb ← vecAtom (kin_velocity s b) "kin_velocity"
175	  let r := Geom.vsub pb pa
176	  let v := Geom.vsub vb va
177	  let vv := Geom.dot v v
178	  if Q.isZero vv then pure none
179	  else
180	    let tstar := Q.neg (Q.div (Geom.dot r v) vv)
181	    if Q.lt tstar Q.zero || Q.gt tstar horizon then pure none
182	    else pure (some (tstar, Geom.norm (Geom.vadd r (Q.mul tstar v.1, Q.mul tstar v.2))))

184	/-- Signed heading change (degrees, left positive) over the back window w, integrated from the yaw
185	    rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sparsely sampled or a yaw rate is missing. -/
186	def prim_heading_change (c : Ctx) (x : TrackId) (w : Q) : Array QR :=
187	  (yawChange c x w).map fun e => match e with
188	    | .error r => .error (match r with
189	        | .windowTruncated _ => .windowTruncated "prim_heading_change"
190	        | .samplingGap _ => .samplingGap "prim_heading_change"
