/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
  What a specification is: binders with class formulas, an applicability and an obligation, and
  the declarations a reviewer needs (parameters, assumptions, declared intentions,
  operationalizations, residues, narrowings, the rules it composes, the surrogate flag).

  A residue is a span of the text the rule does not capture at all; the plan declares it and the
  rule repeats it verbatim. A narrowing is a reading the coder chose on a span the plan does
  carry, stated here so the review judges the rule as it is: the span it names and why. The
  coder may add narrowings and never residues.

  Applicability and obligation are two formulas because a rule whose situation never arises is
  not compliant, it is not engaged: `notApplicable` is a verdict of its own, the witness check can
  demand a scenario for it, and a monitor reads the applicability as the trigger and the
  obligation as what to verify once triggered.

  A surrogate rule (the whole duty is an operationalized standard) is monitored like any other,
  but its verdicts are evidence about the standard, never the law's own verdict; the flag is what
  the monitor and the export propagate so the two are never summed.

  This file holds the declarations only and imports no evaluator: a rule file that imports it
  can state a rule but cannot read a scene, evaluate a formula or build evidence. Evaluation and
  the static check are in RuleEval.lean, which nothing under Rules/ may import.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Formula
import TrafficSpec.Core.Foundations.Unknown

namespace TrafficSpec

/-- A binder: a variable and the class formula (over `ru_*` atoms and class-level derived
    concepts) a track must satisfy to be bound to it. The subject comes first. -/
structure Binder where
  name : String
  cls : Formula
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A reading chosen on a span the record carries, declared where it is made: the span (a
    segmentation id for a rule, a run of the contract's words for a concept) and what the formulas
    state more narrowly than the words. `kind` is `reading` where the words leave the choice open,
    `observable_reading` where a word with no observable counterpart is read through the conduct
    or the feature it refers to, `no_atom` or `no_operator` where the vocabulary or the language
    cannot state the words — a declaration the gate returns for a gap, never a reading the rule
    stands on. -/
structure Narrowing where
  span : String
  why : String
  kind : String := "reading"
  deriving Repr, Inhabited, DecidableEq

structure Rule where
  id : String                                   -- the node id, derived from the law id
  laws : List String                            -- the corpus ids this rule formalizes
  binders : List Binder
  applicability : Formula
  obligation : Formula
  assumptions : List AsmId := []
  intentions : List IntId := []                 -- the declared intentions its formulas read
  operationalizations : List Operationalization := []
  residues : List String := []                  -- what the text says and the rule does not capture
  narrowings : List Narrowing := []             -- readings the coder chose on carried spans
  surrogate : Bool := false
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

inductive Verdict
  | violated
  | compliant
  | notApplicable
  | unknown (why : List UnknownReason)
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited

namespace Verdict
def tag : Verdict → String
  | .violated => "violated"
  | .compliant => "compliant"
  | .notApplicable => "not_applicable"
  | .unknown _ => "unknown"
def reasons : Verdict → List UnknownReason
  | .unknown w => w
  | _ => []
instance : ToString Verdict := ⟨tag⟩
end Verdict

/-- Kleene combination of the two formulas: not engaged ↦ notApplicable, engaged and the
    obligation decided ↦ compliant/violated, anything undecided ↦ unknown with its reasons. -/
def verdictAt (app obl : R) : Verdict :=
  match app.v with
  | .f => .notApplicable
  | .u => .unknown app.why
  | .t =>
    match obl.v with
    | .t => .compliant
    | .f => .violated
    | .u => .unknown obl.why

theorem verdictAt_notApplicable (app obl : R) (h : app.v = .f) : verdictAt app obl = .notApplicable := by
  unfold verdictAt; rw [h]
theorem verdictAt_violated (app obl : R) (ha : app.v = .t) (ho : obl.v = .f) : verdictAt app obl = .violated := by
  unfold verdictAt; rw [ha, ho]
theorem verdictAt_compliant (app obl : R) (ha : app.v = .t) (ho : obl.v = .t) : verdictAt app obl = .compliant := by
  unfold verdictAt; rw [ha, ho]

namespace Rule
/-- The formulas a rule consists of, class formulas first. -/
def formulas (r : Rule) : List Formula := r.binders.map (·.cls) ++ [r.applicability, r.obligation]
/-- Atom, primitive and concept names the rule reads. -/
def atoms (r : Rule) : List String := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.atoms).eraseDups
/-- Reading parameters the rule names. -/
def params (r : Rule) : List ParamName := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.params).eraseDups
/-- Rules the rule composes. -/
def composes (r : Rule) : List String := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.composed).eraseDups
/-- Assumptions the formulas read. -/
def usedAssumptions (r : Rule) : List AsmId := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.assumptions).eraseDups
/-- Declared intentions the formulas read. -/
def usedIntentions (r : Rule) : List IntId := (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.intentions).eraseDups
def binderNames (r : Rule) : List String := r.binders.map (·.name)
def subject (r : Rule) : Option String := r.binders.head?.map (·.name)

/-- The rule and, transitively, the rules it composes (each once). -/
def closure (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : List Rule :=
  let rec go (fuel : Nat) (seen : List String) (todo : List Rule) : List Rule :=
    match fuel, todo with
    | 0, _ | _, [] => []
    | fuel + 1, x :: rest =>
      let next := x.composes.filterMap fun id =>
        if seen.contains id then none else rules.find? (·.id == id)
      x :: go fuel (seen ++ next.map (·.id)) (rest ++ next)
  go (rules.length + 1) [r.id] [r]

/-- Whether the rule reads a declared intention, in its own formulas or through a rule it
    composes at any depth. -/
def readsIntention (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  (closure rules r).any fun x => !x.usedIntentions.isEmpty
end Rule

end TrafficSpec

  a : TrackId
  b : TrackId
  centreDistance : Option Q := none
  surfaceGap : Option (Q × Q) := none        -- nearest-point gap along, across a's heading; ≥ 0
  aAheadOfB : Option Bool := none
  longitudinalOverlap : Option Q := none     -- shared length of the projections on a's heading
  oncoming : Option Bool := none
  sameDirection : Option Bool := none
  bearing : Option Vec := none               -- b relative to a, in a's frame (long, lat)
  contact : Option Bool := none
  visible : Option Bool := none              -- b in a's line of sight
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

/-- A source's declaration current at a scene for one road user at one target region: each id
    listed true or false, an id the declaration does not decide left out. -/
structure DeclaredIntent where
  vehicle : TrackId
  target : RegionId
  values : List (IntId × Bool)
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

structure Scene where
  t : Timestamp
  subject : Option TrackId := none
  users : List RoadUser := []
  structures : List Structure := []

  occupancyObserved : List TrackId := []
  occupies : List (TrackId × RegionId) := []
  relations : List MeasuredRelation := []
  env : Env := {}
  assumptions : List (AsmId × Bool) := []
  intents : List DeclaredIntent := []
  links : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []
  deriving Repr, Inhabited

abbrev Trace := List Scene

namespace Scene
def user (s : Scene) (x : TrackId) : Option RoadUser := s.users.find? (·.track == x)

def tracks (s : Scene) : List TrackId := s.users.map (·.track)
end Scene

  .and (.atom "st_intersection" [jV] [])
    (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [tV, jV] []) leftTurnMade)

def laneDirY (c : Arg) : Term := .measure "st_lane_direction" [c, .lit "y"]

      (.existsRegion (.lit "intersection") "j"
        (.and turnsLeftInJunction

    binders :=

    obligation := obligation

          kind := "reading" } ]
    surrogate := false }

end TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_253_o2

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_253_o2.

  THE GEOMETRY. One junction, a five-metre square at the origin (region 10), where a north-south
  street meets an east-west street. Region 20 is the northbound approach (x from 0 to 2.5 m, south
  of the junction), its designated direction north, its entrance end that junction; region 21 is
  the southbound approach (x from -2.5 to 0 m, north of the junction), its direction south, its
  entrance end the same junction; region 22 is the westbound carrier the van's turn leads into,
  which is an approach to no junction here.

  THE BODIES. Track 1 is the subject, a car 4 m by 1.8 m coming south down region 21 (in one
  witness a bicycle instead). Track 2 is the van, 4.8 m by 2 m, which comes north up region 20 at
  4 m/s, creeps at 1 m/s from the junction mouth and turns left: its yaw rate is 30 deg/s from
  t = 4000 ms to t = 6000 ms, so the heading change accumulated since that onset passes
  forty-five degrees at t = 5500 ms, where the turn is recognized. Through the turn its footprint
  overlaps both its approach carrier and the junction. Track 3, where a witness has one, is a car
  stopped inside the junction on the southbound approach.

  THE INSTANTS. Every trace is 141 scenes at 50 ms, t = 0 to 7000 ms — the sampling period of the
  run's acquisition profile, so the concept's integration is never short of a sample, and long
  enough that every three-second window behind a judged instant is covered. Each witness names
  the instants it speaks about, t = 6000 to 7000 ms: the second after the turn is recognized.
  Before the yaw onset the turn concept is unknown (no onset is observed yet), as its contract
  says, which is what a trace outside the named window would report.

  Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_253_o2
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_253_o2

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mps (n : Int) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond n
def degps (n : Int) : Q := Units.degrees n
/-- A point of the world frame, in centimetres: every coordinate below is exact. -/
def pt (x y : Int) : Vec := (cm x, cm y)

/-- Headings written through the turn: north, north-north-west, north-west. -/
def nnw : Vec := (Units.ratio (-3827) 10000, Units.ratio 9239 10000)
def nw : Vec := (Units.ratio (-7071) 10000, Units.ratio 7071 10000)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: v ↦ 1

/-- The junction: a five-metre square where the two streets meet. -/
def junction : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (cm (-250)) (cm (-250)) (cm 250) (cm 250)

/-- The northbound approach: the carrier by which the van reaches the junction. -/
def northboundApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 20 [pt 0 (-10000), pt 250 (-10000), pt 250 (-250), pt 0 (-250)]
    Build.north (enters := some 10)

/-- The southbound approach: the carrier the subject occupies, its direction the opposed one. -/
def southboundApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 21 [pt (-250) 250, pt 0 250, pt 0 10000, pt (-250) 10000]
    Build.south (enters := some 10)

/-- The westbound carrier the van's turn leads into: an approach to no junction here. -/
def westboundExit : Structure :=
  Build.lane 22 [pt (-10000) 0, pt (-250) 0, pt (-250) 250, pt (-10000) 250] Build.west

def roads : List Structure := [junction, northboundApproach, southboundApproach, westboundExit]

/-- A clear, dry afternoon. -/
def weather : Env :=
  { darkness := some false, precipitation := some false, wetRoad := some false,
    iceOrSnow := some false, visibility := some (m 300) }

/-- What the source declares about the van's plan at the junction. -/
def vanIntent (v : Bool) : DeclaredIntent :=
  { vehicle := 2, target := 10,
    values := [("int.turn_left", v), ("int.left_turn", v), ("int.turn_to_the_left", v)] }

/-- The subject car: 4 m by 1.8 m, no yaw, no signal of its own. -/
def car (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals (Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] pos heading speed (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero, accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The subject in the witness where it is a bicycle, which the aggregate does not include. -/
def cycle (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals (Build.user 1 [.bicycle] pos heading speed (cm 90, cm 30, cm 90))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero, accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The van's reference point: north up the approach at 4 m/s to the junction mouth, then one
    metre per second through the turn, then halted inside the junction (or still creeping). -/
def vanPos (k : Nat) (halt : Bool) : Vec :=
  let i : Int := k
  if k ≤ 80 then pt 130 (-2000 + 20 * i)
  else if k ≤ 100 then pt 130 (-400 + 5 * (i - 80))
  else if k ≤ 110 then pt (130 - 2 * (i - 100)) (-300 + 5 * (i - 100))
  else if k ≤ 120 then pt (110 - 4 * (i - 110)) (-250 + 4 * (i - 110))
  else if halt then pt 70 (-210)
  else pt (70 - 4 * (i - 120)) (-210 + 4 * (i - 120))

def vanHeading (k : Nat) : Vec :=
  if k ≤ 100 then Build.north else if k ≤ 110 then nnw else nw

def vanSpeed (k : Nat) (halt : Bool) : Q :=
  if k ≤ 80 then mps 4 else if k ≤ 120 then mps 1 else if halt then Q.zero else mps 1

/-- The van's yaw rate: the turn's onset at t = 4000 ms, held to t = 6000 ms. -/
def vanYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 119 then degps 30 else Q.zero

/-- The yaw rate of a body that bends slightly to the left and makes no left turn: an onset is
    observed, and the heading change accumulated since it stays far below the turn angle. -/
def bendYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 89 then degps 6 else Q.zero

/-- The van, with the indication it shows and whether it is halted where its turn is recognized. -/
def vanAt (k : Nat) (ind : TurnIndicatorState) (hand : HandSignal) (halt : Bool) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (vanPos k halt) (vanHeading k) (vanSpeed k halt)
        (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some ind, handSignal := some hand }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (vanYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The van's stated occupancy: its approach carrier throughout, and the junction from the moment
    its nose crosses the junction mouth. -/
def vanOcc (k : Nat) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  if k ≤ 75 then [(2, 20)] else [(2, 20), (2, 10)]

/-- A southbound body's stated occupancy, from the height of its reference point (centimetres):
    its approach carrier while its rear is north of the junction mouth, the junction while its
    nose is south of it. -/
def southboundOcc (track : TrackId) (ycm : Int) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  (if ycm ≥ 50 then [(track, 21)] else []) ++
  (if ycm ≤ 450 then (if ycm ≥ -450 then [(track, 10)] else []) else [])

/-- The vehicle that runs north through the junction with a slight bend, making no left turn. -/
def straightVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let i : Int := k
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (pt 130 (-2000 + 20 * i)) Build.north (mps 4)
        (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (bendYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

def straightOcc (k : Nat) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  let y : Int := -2000 + 20 * (k : Int)
  (if y ≤ -10 then [(2, 20)] else []) ++
  (if y ≥ -490 then (if y ≤ 490 then [(2, 10)] else []) else [])

/-- A car that came south down the approach and stopped inside the junction, where the van's
    turn crosses it. -/
def crossedVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let i : Int := k
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (pt (-100) (if k ≤ 92 then 2000 - 20 * i else 160))
        Build.south (if k ≤ 92 then mps 4 else Q.zero) (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (bendYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

def crossedY (k : Nat) : Int := if k ≤ 92 then 2000 - 20 * (k : Int) else 160

/-- A scene of a witness: the bodies, the roads, the stated occupancy and the declarations. -/
def sceneOf (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) (occ : List (TrackId × RegionId))
    (intents : List DeclaredIntent) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users roads [] (some occ) weather [] intents

/-- 141 scenes at the acquisition profile's 50 ms, t = 0 to 7000 ms. -/
def traceOf (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace := Build.trace 141 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) f

/-- The subject braking well short of the junction: 4 m/s, then one metre per second. -/
def clearCarY (k : Nat) : Int :=
  let i : Int := k
  if k ≤ 90 then 3400 - 20 * i else 1600 - 5 * (i - 90)
def clearCarSpeed (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 90 then mps 4 else mps 1

/-- `forbid` (violated): A van within a junction has yielded to the opposing stream, shows its left indicator through the two seconds before its turn is recognized, and turns left. The subject car occupies the opposing approach lane entering the same junction and drives on into the van's path, the two bodies touching. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 3400 - 25 * (k : Int)

def roads : List Structure := [junction, northboundApproach, southboundApproach, westboundExit]

/-- A clear, dry afternoon. -/
def weather : Env :=

    iceOrSnow := some false, visibility := some (m 300) }

  { vehicle := 2, target := 10,
    values := [("int.turn_left", v), ("int.left_turn", v), ("int.turn_to_the_left", v)] }

/-- The subject car: 4 m by 1.8 m, no yaw, no signal of its own. -/
def car (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=

    (Build.withSignals (Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] pos heading speed (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero, accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The subject in the witness where it is a bicycle, which the aggregate does not include. -/
def cycle (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=

    (Build.withSignals (Build.user 1 [.bicycle] pos heading speed (cm 90, cm 30, cm 90))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero, accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

    metre per second through the turn, then halted inside the junction (or still creeping). -/

  let i : Int := k
  if k ≤ 80 then pt 130 (-2000 + 20 * i)
  else if k ≤ 100 then pt 130 (-400 + 5 * (i - 80))
  else if k ≤ 110 then pt (130 - 2 * (i - 100)) (-300 + 5 * (i - 100))
  else if k ≤ 120 then pt (110 - 4 * (i - 110)) (-250 + 4 * (i - 110))
  else if halt then pt 70 (-210)
  else pt (70 - 4 * (i - 120)) (-210 + 4 * (i - 120))

def vanHeading (k : Nat) : Vec :=
  if k ≤ 100 then Build.north else if k ≤ 110 then nnw else nw

def vanSpeed (k : Nat) (halt : Bool) : Q :=
  if k ≤ 80 then mps 4 else if k ≤ 120 then mps 1 else if halt then Q.zero else mps 1

/-- The van's yaw rate: the turn's onset at t = 4000 ms, held to t = 6000 ms. -/
def vanYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 119 then degps 30 else Q.zero

/-- The yaw rate of a body that bends slightly to the left and makes no left turn: an onset is
    observed, and the heading change accumulated since it stays far below the turn angle. -/
def bendYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 89 then degps 6 else Q.zero

/-- The van, with the indication it shows and whether it is halted where its turn is recognized. -/
def vanAt (k : Nat) (ind : TurnIndicatorState) (hand : HandSignal) (halt : Bool) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (vanPos k halt) (vanHeading k) (vanSpeed k halt)
        (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some ind, handSignal := some hand }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (vanYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The van's stated occupancy: its approach carrier throughout, and the junction from the moment
    its nose crosses the junction mouth. -/
def vanOcc (k : Nat) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  if k ≤ 75 then [(2, 20)] else [(2, 20), (2, 10)]

/-- A southbound body's stated occupancy, from the height of its reference point (centimetres):
    its approach carrier while its rear is north of the junction mouth, the junction while its
    nose is south of it. -/
def southboundOcc (track : TrackId) (ycm : Int) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  (if ycm ≥ 50 then [(track, 21)] else []) ++
  (if ycm ≤ 450 then (if ycm ≥ -450 then [(track, 10)] else []) else [])

/-- The vehicle that runs north through the junction with a slight bend, making no left turn. -/
def straightVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let i : Int := k
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (pt 130 (-2000 + 20 * i)) Build.north (mps 4)
        (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (bendYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

def straightOcc (k : Nat) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  let y : Int := -2000 + 20 * (k : Int)
  (if y ≤ -10 then [(2, 20)] else []) ++
  (if y ≥ -490 then (if y ≤ 490 then [(2, 10)] else []) else [])

/-- A car that came south down the approach and stopped inside the junction, where the van's
    turn crosses it. -/
def crossedVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let i : Int := k
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (pt (-100) (if k ≤ 92 then 2000 - 20 * i else 160))
        Build.south (if k ≤ 92 then mps 4 else Q.zero) (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (bendYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

def crossedY (k : Nat) : Int := if k ≤ 92 then 2000 - 20 * (k : Int) else 160

/-- A scene of a witness: the bodies, the roads, the stated occupancy and the declarations. -/
def sceneOf (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) (occ : List (TrackId × RegionId))
    (intents : List DeclaredIntent) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users roads [] (some occ) weather [] intents

/-- 141 scenes at the acquisition profile's 50 ms, t = 0 to 7000 ms. -/
def traceOf (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace := Build.trace 141 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) f

/-- The subject braking well short of the junction: 4 m/s, then one metre per second. -/
def clearCarY (k : Nat) : Int :=
  let i : Int := k
  if k ≤ 90 then 3400 - 20 * i else 1600 - 5 * (i - 90)
def clearCarSpeed (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 90 then mps 4 else mps 1

/-- `forbid` (violated): A van within a junction has yielded to the opposing stream, shows its left indicator through the two seconds before its turn is recognized, and turns left. The subject car occupies the opposing approach lane entering the same junction and drives on into the van's path, the two bodies touching. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 3400 - 25 * (k : Int)
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-100) y) Build.south (mps 5), vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same junction and the same signalled, yielded left turn by the van. The subject car brakes on its approach and stays more than ten metres clear of the van throughout, no closest approach within the horizon coming near the clearance bound. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k),
               vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject car occupies the opposing approach lane of a junction in which no vehicle is making a left turn at all: no road user raises the duty, so the rule is not engaged. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k), straightVehicle k]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ straightOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `blind` (unknown): A van makes a signalled left turn in the junction the subject approaches, but the source does not report whether the van's footprint overlaps the junction region, so whether the turn is the one made in that intersection is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := permitTrace

  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k),

      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k),

      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k ++ southboundOcc 3 (crossedY k))

    turns. The subject car has stopped on its approach well short of the junction: standing, it
    grants precedence. -/

    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) y) Build.south (if k ≤ 100 then mps 4 else Q.zero),

      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

    car holds 8 m/s down its approach, twenty metres short: the bodies are far apart, but the
    closest approach their velocities predict within the horizon is under two metres. -/

  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 6800 - 40 * (k : Int)

      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

    and ends up less than a metre from its flank without touching it: their centres do not
    approach within the horizon, and the gap between the nearest points of the two bodies is

    sceneOf t [car (pt (-200) y) Build.south (if k ≤ 119 then mps 2 else Units.micrometresPerSecond 400000),
               vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

    (window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (6000, 7000)) : Scenario :=
  { name := name

    grounding := [("v", 1)]

  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["rel.occupies"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable

  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_6" branch_6Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_7" branch_7Trace .notApplicable ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_253_o2

5	/-
6	  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Grounding
7	  Which assignments of tracks to binders exist over a trace, how a broken track is followed, and
8	  the per-grounding timeline of verdicts.
9	
10	  A track is a source's identity, not an object's. When a tracker breaks and the adapter claims a
11	  continuation (`Scene.links`, old ↦ new), the trace is rewritten once to canonical identities
12	  when the break is shorter than the manifest's re-identification gap; the instants inside the gap
13	  are unknown (identityGap), never a fresh party. A binder whose track is not present at an
14	  instant outside any gap leaves the rule not engaged there: the other party has left the scene.
15	
16	  Groundings are tuples of distinct candidates that are co-present at some instant; each
17	  grounding evaluates the rule once over the whole trace, and formulas that depend on a subset of
18	  the binders are shared across the groundings that agree on that subset.
19	
20	  Rules never import this file: a rule that could see the census of tracks could special-case it.
21	-/
22	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
23	import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
24	
25	namespace TrafficSpec
26	namespace Grounding
27	open Semantics
28	
29	/-- An assignment of canonical tracks to binder names, and of regions to the variables a
30	    concept's instance takes as region formals (a rule's groundings bind none). -/
31	structure Grounding where
32	  assign : List (String × TrackId)
33	  regions : List (String × RegionId) := []
34	  deriving Repr, DecidableEq, Inhabited
35	
36	def Grounding.render (g : Grounding) : String :=
37	  String.intercalate "," (g.assign.map fun (n, t) => s!"{n}={t}")
38	def Grounding.binding (g : Grounding) : Binding :=
39	  ⟨g.assign.map (fun (n, t) => (n, Val.track t)) ++ g.regions.map fun (n, r) => (n, Val.region r)⟩
40	
41	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
42	-- Identity: canonical tracks through accepted links, applied to the trace once
43	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
44	/-- The scene with every track id replaced by its canonical identity. -/
45	def canonicalScene (cm : List (TrackId × TrackId)) (s : Scene) : Scene :=
46	  let c := canon cm
47	  { s with
48	    subject := s.subject.map c
49	    users := s.users.map fun u => { u with track := c u.track }
50	    occupancyObserved := s.occupancyObserved.map c
51	    occupies := s.occupies.map fun (t, r) => (c t, r)
52	    relations := s.relations.map fun m => { m with a := c m.a, b := c m.b }
53	    intents := s.intents.map fun d => { d with vehicle := c d.vehicle } }
54	
55	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
56	-- Setup: the canonical, indexed trace and the rule set
57	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
58	structure Setup where
59	  rules : List Rule
60	  d : Primitives.Ctx
61	  gap : Q
62	  cm : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []
63	
64	def Setup.mk' (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Setup :=
65	  let arr := τ.toArray
66	  let cm := canonMap arr gap
67	  { rules := rules, d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' (τ.map (canonicalScene cm)) ρ, gap := gap, cm := cm }
68	
69	/-- The setup of a trace every evaluation reaches: built only when `Admission.defects` finds no
70	    defect in the trace as written, else the defects. -/
71	def Setup.admit (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Except (List String) Setup :=
72	  match Admission.defects τ gap with
73	  | [] => .ok (Setup.mk' rules τ ρ gap)
74	  | ds => .error ds
75	
76	def Setup.n (S : Setup) : Nat := S.d.n
77	def Setup.scenes (S : Setup) : Array Scene := S.d.scenes
78	def Setup.ctx (S : Setup) (β : Binding) : SemCtx := Rule.context S.rules S.d β
79	def Setup.tracks (S : Setup) : List TrackId := (S.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
80	/-- First and last instant at which a canonical identity is present. -/
81	def Setup.span (S : Setup) (t : TrackId) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
82	  match firstSeen S.scenes t, lastSeen S.scenes t with
83	  | some a, some b => some (a, b)
84	  | _, _ => none
85	
86	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
87	-- Enumeration
88	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
89	/-- Tracks that satisfy a binder's class at some instant (evaluated once per track). -/
90	def candidates (S : Setup) (b : Binder) : List TrackId :=
91	  S.tracks.filter fun t =>
92	    (Rule.evalRuleFormula (S.ctx ⟨[(b.name, .track t)]⟩) b.cls).any fun r => r.v == .t
93	
94	def spansOverlap (S : Setup) (a b : TrackId) : Bool :=
95	  match S.span a, S.span b with
96	  | some (a0, a1), some (b0, b1) => a0 ≤ b1 && b0 ≤ a1
97	  | _, _ => false
98	
99	/-- All assignments of distinct, pairwise co-present candidates to the binders, subject first.
100	    Each binder's candidates are computed once. -/
101	def groundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List Grounding :=
102	  let cands := r.binders.map fun b => (b.name, candidates S b)
103	  let rec go (bs : List (String × List TrackId)) (used : List TrackId) : List (List (String × TrackId)) :=
104	    match bs with
105	    | [] => [[]]
106	    | (name, cs) :: rest =>
107	      cs.filter (fun c => !used.contains c && used.all (spansOverlap S c)) |>.flatMap fun c =>
108	        (go rest (c :: used)).map fun tail => (name, c) :: tail
109	  (go cands []).map fun a => { assign := a }
110	
111	/-- Predicted grounding count without enumerating: the product of candidate counts (an upper
112	    bound when candidates overlap). -/
113	def predictedGroundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Nat :=
114	  r.binders.foldl (fun acc b => acc * (candidates S b).length) 1
115	
116	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
117	-- Timelines
118	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
119	/-- One evaluation of a rule for a grounding: the verdict per instant, whether the rule was
120	    engaged at some instant with every party present, and whether every party was present at
121	    some instant at all. -/
122	structure Timeline where
123	  verdicts : Array (Timestamp × Verdict)
124	  live : Bool
125	  present : Bool
126	  deriving Repr
127	
128	/-- Evaluate a rule for a grounding once. A binder absent inside its identity's span is an
129	    identity gap (unknown); absent outside it, the rule is not engaged. -/
130	def evaluate (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Timeline :=
131	  let c := S.ctx g.binding
132	  let engaged := r.engagedAll c
133	  let obl := Rule.evalRuleFormula c r.obligation
134	  let spans := g.assign.map fun (_, t) => (t, S.span t)
135	  let rows := (Array.range S.n).map fun i =>
136	    let s := S.scenes[i]!
137	    let missing := spans.filter fun (t, _) => !s.tracks.contains t
138	    let v : Verdict :=
139	      if missing.isEmpty then verdictAt engaged[i]! obl[i]!
140	      else
141	        let inGap := missing.filter fun (_, sp) => match sp with
142	          | some (a, b) => a < i && i < b
143	          | none => false
144	        if inGap.isEmpty then .notApplicable
145	        else .unknown (inGap.map fun (t, _) => .identityGap t)
146	    (s.t, v, missing.isEmpty && engaged[i]!.v == .t, missing.isEmpty)
147	  ⟨rows.map fun (t, v, _, _) => (t, v), rows.any fun (_, _, l, _) => l, rows.any fun (_, _, _, p) => p⟩
148	
149	def timeline (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Array (Timestamp × Verdict) := (evaluate S r g).verdicts
150	
151	/-- The verdict of a grounding at one instant. -/
152	def verdictAt (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) (i : Nat) : Verdict :=
153	  ((timeline S r g)[i]?).map (·.2) |>.getD (.unknown [.outOfRange])
154	
155	/-- The episode verdict: a violation anywhere is a violation; else any unknown is unknown (with
156	    every reason); else engaged anywhere is compliant; else not applicable. -/
157	def episode (tl : List Verdict) : Verdict :=
158	  if tl.any (· == .violated) then .violated
159	  else
160	    let unknowns := tl.flatMap Verdict.reasons
161	    if tl.any (fun v => match v with | .unknown _ => true | _ => false) then .unknown unknowns.eraseDups
162	    else if tl.any (· == .compliant) then .compliant
163	    else .notApplicable
164	
165	/-- Every grounding evaluated once: its episode verdict and timeline. -/
166	def check (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List (Grounding × Timeline × Verdict) :=
167	  (groundings S r).map fun g =>
168	    let tl := evaluate S r g
169	    (g, tl, episode (tl.verdicts.toList.map (·.2)))
170	
171	/-- Engaged (applicability true) at some instant for some grounding: the rule says something on
172	    this trace. -/
173	def live (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Bool := (check S r).any fun (_, tl, _) => tl.live
174	
175	end Grounding
176	end TrafficSpec

  gap : Q
  cm : List (TrackId × TrackId) := []

def Setup.mk' (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Setup :=
  let arr := τ.toArray
  let cm := canonMap arr gap
  { rules := rules, d := Primitives.Ctx.mk' (τ.map (canonicalScene cm)) ρ, gap := gap, cm := cm }

/-- The setup of a trace every evaluation reaches: built only when `Admission.defects` finds no
    defect in the trace as written, else the defects. -/
def Setup.admit (rules : List Rule) (τ : Trace) (ρ : Reading) (gap : Q) : Except (List String) Setup :=
  match Admission.defects τ gap with
  | [] => .ok (Setup.mk' rules τ ρ gap)
  | ds => .error ds

def Setup.n (S : Setup) : Nat := S.d.n
def Setup.scenes (S : Setup) : Array Scene := S.d.scenes
def Setup.ctx (S : Setup) (β : Binding) : SemCtx := Rule.context S.rules S.d β
def Setup.tracks (S : Setup) : List TrackId := (S.scenes.toList.flatMap (·.tracks)).eraseDups
/-- First and last instant at which a canonical identity is present. -/
def Setup.span (S : Setup) (t : TrackId) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  match firstSeen S.scenes t, lastSeen S.scenes t with
  | some a, some b => some (a, b)
  | _, _ => none

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enumeration
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Tracks that satisfy a binder's class at some instant (evaluated once per track). -/
def candidates (S : Setup) (b : Binder) : List TrackId :=
  S.tracks.filter fun t =>
    (Rule.evalRuleFormula (S.ctx ⟨[(b.name, .track t)]⟩) b.cls).any fun r => r.v == .t

def spansOverlap (S : Setup) (a b : TrackId) : Bool :=
  match S.span a, S.span b with
  | some (a0, a1), some (b0, b1) => a0 ≤ b1 && b0 ≤ a1
  | _, _ => false

/-- All assignments of distinct, pairwise co-present candidates to the binders, subject first.
    Each binder's candidates are computed once. -/
def groundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List Grounding :=
  let cands := r.binders.map fun b => (b.name, candidates S b)
  let rec go (bs : List (String × List TrackId)) (used : List TrackId) : List (List (String × TrackId)) :=
    match bs with
    | [] => [[]]
    | (name, cs) :: rest =>
      cs.filter (fun c => !used.contains c && used.all (spansOverlap S c)) |>.flatMap fun c =>
        (go rest (c :: used)).map fun tail => (name, c) :: tail
  (go cands []).map fun a => { assign := a }

/-- Predicted grounding count without enumerating: the product of candidate counts (an upper
    bound when candidates overlap). -/
def predictedGroundings (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Nat :=
  r.binders.foldl (fun acc b => acc * (candidates S b).length) 1

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Timelines
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- One evaluation of a rule for a grounding: the verdict per instant, whether the rule was
    engaged at some instant with every party present, and whether every party was present at
    some instant at all. -/
structure Timeline where
  verdicts : Array (Timestamp × Verdict)
  live : Bool
  present : Bool
  deriving Repr

/-- Evaluate a rule for a grounding once. A binder absent inside its identity's span is an
    identity gap (unknown); absent outside it, the rule is not engaged. -/
def evaluate (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Timeline :=
  let c := S.ctx g.binding
  let engaged := r.engagedAll c
  let obl := Rule.evalRuleFormula c r.obligation
  let spans := g.assign.map fun (_, t) => (t, S.span t)
  let rows := (Array.range S.n).map fun i =>
    let s := S.scenes[i]!
    let missing := spans.filter fun (t, _) => !s.tracks.contains t
    let v : Verdict :=
      if missing.isEmpty then verdictAt engaged[i]! obl[i]!
      else
        let inGap := missing.filter fun (_, sp) => match sp with
          | some (a, b) => a < i && i < b
          | none => false
        if inGap.isEmpty then .notApplicable
        else .unknown (inGap.map fun (t, _) => .identityGap t)
    (s.t, v, missing.isEmpty && engaged[i]!.v == .t, missing.isEmpty)
  ⟨rows.map fun (t, v, _, _) => (t, v), rows.any fun (_, _, l, _) => l, rows.any fun (_, _, _, p) => p⟩

def timeline (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) : Array (Timestamp × Verdict) := (evaluate S r g).verdicts

/-- The verdict of a grounding at one instant. -/
def verdictAt (S : Setup) (r : Rule) (g : Grounding) (i : Nat) : Verdict :=
  ((timeline S r g)[i]?).map (·.2) |>.getD (.unknown [.outOfRange])

/-- The episode verdict: a violation anywhere is a violation; else any unknown is unknown (with
    every reason); else engaged anywhere is compliant; else not applicable. -/
def episode (tl : List Verdict) : Verdict :=
  if tl.any (· == .violated) then .violated
  else
    let unknowns := tl.flatMap Verdict.reasons
    if tl.any (fun v => match v with | .unknown _ => true | _ => false) then .unknown unknowns.eraseDups
    else if tl.any (· == .compliant) then .compliant
    else .notApplicable

/-- Every grounding evaluated once: its episode verdict and timeline. -/
def check (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : List (Grounding × Timeline × Verdict) :=
  (groundings S r).map fun g =>
    let tl := evaluate S r g
    (g, tl, episode (tl.verdicts.toList.map (·.2)))

/-- Engaged (applicability true) at some instant for some grounding: the rule says something on
    this trace. -/
def live (S : Setup) (r : Rule) : Bool := (check S r).any fun (_, tl, _) => tl.live

end Grounding
end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Admission
  What a trace must satisfy, as written, before any rule is evaluated on it: the declared facts
  (assumptions and intentions) name what their scene holds, each once, by well-formed ids; no
  structure is labelled with an abstract kind or lists one among the kinds its source cannot tell
  (an abstract kind is the union of the kinds refining it, read only by a formula); and the
  accepted re-identification links are one-to-one.

  The checks are exact and read no geometry, so a recorded trace, a JSON case and a Lean witness
  are held to them alike. `Grounding.Setup.admit` calls them; every evaluation builds its setup
  there.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Runtime.Identity
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Assumptions
import TrafficSpec.Core.Vocab.Intentions

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Admission

private def duplicates {α : Type} [BEq α] (xs : List α) : List α :=
  (xs.filter fun x => xs.count x > 1).eraseDups

/-- The defects of one scene's declared facts. -/
def sceneDefects (s : Scene) : List String :=
  let at_ := s!"scene t={s.t}"
  (s.intents.flatMap fun d =>
    let who := s!"{at_}: intent record ({d.vehicle}, {d.target})"
    (if s.tracks.contains d.vehicle then [] else [s!"{who}: vehicle {d.vehicle} is not a road user of the scene"]) ++
    (if (s.structure? d.target).isSome then [] else [s!"{who}: target {d.target} is not a structure of the scene"]) ++
    ((duplicates (d.values.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` listed more than once") ++
    ((d.values.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!IntId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: `{id}` is not a well-formed intention id")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.intents.map fun d => (d.vehicle, d.target))).map fun (v, r) => s!"{at_}: more than one intent record for ({v}, {r})") ++
  (s.structures.flatMap fun st =>
    (if st.kind.isAbstract then [s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} is labelled `{st.kind}`, an abstract kind; label it with a kind that refines `{st.kind}`"] else []) ++
    ((st.unobservedKinds.filter (·.isAbstract)).eraseDups.map fun k =>
      s!"{at_}: structure {st.id} lists `{k}` among unobserved_kinds, an abstract kind; list the kinds refining it that the source cannot tell")) ++
  ((duplicates (s.assumptions.map (·.1))).map fun id => s!"{at_}: assumption `{id}` listed more than once") ++
  ((s.assumptions.map (·.1)).eraseDups.filter (!AsmId.wellFormed ·) |>.map fun id => s!"{at_}: `{id}` is not a well-formed assumption id")

/-- Accepted links that give a track two successors or two predecessors. -/
def linkDefects (τ : Array Scene) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  let links := Grounding.acceptedLinks τ gap
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.1))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} is continued by more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.1 == t)}") ++
  ((duplicates (links.map (·.2))).map fun t =>
    s!"track {t} continues more than one accepted link: {links.filter (·.2 == t)}")

/-- Every defect of the trace as written; empty for a trace every evaluation may read. -/
def defects (τ : Trace) (gap : Q) : List String :=
  τ.flatMap sceneDefects ++ linkDefects τ.toArray gap

end Admission
end TrafficSpec

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_253_o2.

  THE GEOMETRY. One junction, a five-metre square at the origin (region 10), where a north-south
  street meets an east-west street. Region 20 is the northbound approach (x from 0 to 2.5 m, south
  of the junction), its designated direction north, its entrance end that junction; region 21 is
  the southbound approach (x from -2.5 to 0 m, north of the junction), its direction south, its
  entrance end the same junction; region 22 is the westbound carrier the van's turn leads into,
  which is an approach to no junction here.

  THE BODIES. Track 1 is the subject, a car 4 m by 1.8 m coming south down region 21 (in one
  witness a bicycle instead). Track 2 is the van, 4.8 m by 2 m, which comes north up region 20 at
  4 m/s, stands from t = 3950 ms with its reference point at (1.3, -1.8) m — in the junction
  mouth, its footprint overlapping both its approach carrier and the junction throughout — and
  from t = 4000 ms swings to the left at 30 deg/s: one and a half degrees between consecutive
  scenes, written as an exact rational rotation of its heading, so that heading and yaw rate say
  the same thing at every scene. The heading change accumulated since that onset passes
  forty-five degrees at t = 5500 ms, where its left turn is recognized, and reaches ninety
  degrees by the end. Track 3, where a witness has one, is a car that came south down region 21
  and stopped in the junction, across the van's turn.

  Every body here either stands or runs straight at a constant speed, its position advancing by
  the speed of the scene over the interval before it, so that no scene asserts a motion its own
  figures deny.

  THE INSTANTS. Every trace is 141 scenes at 50 ms, t = 0 to 7000 ms — the sampling period of the
  run's acquisition profile, so the concept's integration is never short of a sample, and long
  enough that every three-second window behind a judged instant is covered. Each witness names
  the instants it speaks about, t = 6000 to 7000 ms: the second and a half after the turn is
  recognized. Before the yaw onset the turn concept is unknown, as its contract says: no onset is
  observed yet.

  Every figure here is the witness's own and appears nowhere in the rule.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_253_o2
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_253_o2

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mps (n : Int) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond n
def degps (n : Int) : Q := Units.degrees n
/-- A point of the world frame, in centimetres: every coordinate below is exact. -/
def pt (x y : Int) : Vec := (cm x, cm y)

/-- The rotation to the left by one step of the van's turn: the one and a half degrees its yaw
    rate of 30 deg/s makes over the 50 ms before a scene, as an exact rational rotation. -/
def stepCos : Q := Units.ratio 9996573 10000000
def stepSin : Q := Units.ratio 261769 10000000

/-- Keep a coordinate to a tenth of a micrometre, so the sixty steps of the turn stay small
    exact rationals; the angle between consecutive headings is unaffected at this resolution. -/
def trim (q : Q) : Q := Units.ratio ((q.num * 10000000) / Int.ofNat q.den) 10000000

def rotLeft (v : Vec) : Vec :=
  (trim (Q.sub (Q.mul v.1 stepCos) (Q.mul v.2 stepSin)),
   trim (Q.add (Q.mul v.1 stepSin) (Q.mul v.2 stepCos)))

/-- `n` steps of that rotation. -/
def rotN : Nat → Vec → Vec
  | 0, v => v
  | n + 1, v => rotLeft (rotN n v)

-- Binders ↦ tracks: v ↦ 1

/-- The junction: a five-metre square where the two streets meet. -/
def junction : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (cm (-250)) (cm (-250)) (cm 250) (cm 250)

/-- The northbound approach: the carrier by which the van reaches the junction. -/
def northboundApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 20 [pt 0 (-10000), pt 250 (-10000), pt 250 (-250), pt 0 (-250)]
    Build.north (enters := some 10)

/-- The southbound approach: the carrier the subject occupies, its direction the opposed one. -/
def southboundApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 21 [pt (-250) 250, pt 0 250, pt 0 10000, pt (-250) 10000]
    Build.south (enters := some 10)

/-- The westbound carrier the van's turn leads into: an approach to no junction here. -/
def westboundExit : Structure :=
  Build.lane 22 [pt (-10000) 0, pt (-250) 0, pt (-250) 250, pt (-10000) 250] Build.west

def roads : List Structure := [junction, northboundApproach, southboundApproach, westboundExit]

/-- A clear, dry afternoon. -/
def weather : Env :=
  { darkness := some false, precipitation := some false, wetRoad := some false,
    iceOrSnow := some false, visibility := some (m 300) }

/-- What the source declares about the van's plan at the junction. -/
def vanIntent (v : Bool) : DeclaredIntent :=
  { vehicle := 2, target := 10,
    values := [("int.turn_left", v), ("int.left_turn", v), ("int.turn_to_the_left", v)] }

/-- The subject car: 4 m by 1.8 m, running straight south, no signal of its own. -/
def car (ycm : Int) (xcm : Int) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] (pt xcm ycm) Build.south speed (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero })

/-- The subject in the witness where it is a bicycle, which the aggregate does not include. -/
def cycle (ycm : Int) (xcm : Int) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 1 [.bicycle] (pt xcm ycm) Build.south speed (cm 90, cm 30, cm 90))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero })

/-- The van's reference point: north up the approach at 4 m/s, then standing in the junction
    mouth from t = 3950 ms. -/
def vanPos (k : Nat) : Vec :=
  if k ≤ 79 then pt 130 (-1760 + 20 * (k : Int)) else pt 130 (-180)

def vanSpeed (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then mps 4 else Q.zero

/-- The van's heading: north until it stands, then one and a half degrees further to the left at
    every scene from t = 4000 ms, the rotation its yaw rate makes over the interval before it. -/
def vanHeading (k : Nat) : Vec := if k ≤ 79 then Build.north else rotN (k - 79) Build.north

/-- The van's yaw rate: the onset of the turn at t = 4000 ms, held to the end of the trace. -/
def vanYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else degps 30

/-- The van, with the indication it shows. -/
def vanAt (k : Nat) (ind : TurnIndicatorState) (hand : HandSignal) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (vanPos k) (vanHeading k) (vanSpeed k) (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some ind, handSignal := some hand }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (vanYaw k) })

/-- The van's stated occupancy: its approach carrier throughout, and the junction from the moment
    its nose crosses the junction mouth. -/
def vanOcc (k : Nat) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  if k ≤ 43 then [(2, 20)] else [(2, 20), (2, 10)]

/-- A southbound car's stated occupancy, from the height of its reference point (centimetres):
    its approach carrier while its rear is north of the junction mouth, the junction while its
    nose is south of it. -/
def southboundOcc (track : TrackId) (ycm : Int) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  (if ycm ≥ 50 then [(track, 21)] else []) ++
  (if ycm ≤ 450 then (if ycm ≥ -450 then [(track, 10)] else []) else [])

/-- The vehicle that rolled up to the junction mouth and stands there, its nose settling three
    degrees to the left: an onset of turning is observed, and the heading change accumulated
    since it stays far below the turn angle, so it makes no left turn. -/
def twitchVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (vanPos k)
        (if k ≤ 79 then Build.north else rotN (min (k - 79) 2) Build.north) (vanSpeed k)
        (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 81 then degps 30 else Q.zero) })

/-- A car that came south down the approach at 4 m/s and stopped in the junction, where the van's
    turn crosses it; its nose settles three degrees to the left, so that whether it makes a left
    turn of its own is decided and not unknown. -/
def crossedVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (pt (-100) (if k ≤ 70 then 1500 - 20 * (k : Int) else 100))
        (if k ≤ 79 then Build.south else rotN (min (k - 79) 2) Build.south)
        (if k ≤ 70 then mps 4 else Q.zero) (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 81 then degps 30 else Q.zero) })

def crossedY (k : Nat) : Int := if k ≤ 70 then 1500 - 20 * (k : Int) else 100

/-- A scene of a witness: the bodies, the roads, the stated occupancy and the declarations. -/
def sceneOf (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) (occ : List (TrackId × RegionId))
    (intents : List DeclaredIntent) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users roads [] (some occ) weather [] intents

/-- 141 scenes at the acquisition profile's 50 ms, t = 0 to 7000 ms. -/
def traceOf (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace := Build.trace 141 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) f

/-- The subject braking well short of the junction: 4 m/s, then one metre per second. -/
def clearCarY (k : Nat) : Int :=
  let i : Int := k
  if k ≤ 90 then 3400 - 20 * i else 1600 - 5 * (i - 90)
def clearCarSpeed (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 90 then mps 4 else mps 1

/-- `forbid` (violated): A van within a junction has yielded to the opposing stream, shows its left indicator through the two seconds before its turn is recognized, and turns left. The subject car occupies the opposing approach lane entering the same junction and drives on into the van's path, the two bodies touching. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 3590 - 25 * (k : Int)
    sceneOf t [car y (-100) (mps 5), vanAt k .left .noSignal]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same junction and the same signalled, yielded left turn by the van. The subject car brakes on its approach and stays more than ten metres clear of the van throughout, no closest approach within the horizon coming near the clearance bound. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (clearCarY k) (-120) (clearCarSpeed k), vanAt k .left .noSignal]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject car occupies the opposing approach lane of a junction in which no vehicle is making a left turn at all: no road user raises the duty, so the rule is not engaged. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (clearCarY k) (-120) (clearCarSpeed k), twitchVehicle k]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `blind` (unknown): A van makes a signalled left turn in the junction the subject approaches, but the source does not report whether the van's footprint overlaps the junction region, so whether the turn is the one made in that intersection is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := permitTrace

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): The van turns left in the junction and has yielded to the opposing stream, but its indicator stays off and it gives no arm signal in the window behind the recognition of the turn: the weaker fact -- a turn made without the signal the words require -- leaves the other drivers' duty unraised, and the rule is not engaged. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (clearCarY k) (-120) (clearCarSpeed k), vanAt k .off .noSignal]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): The van signals left and turns, but it did not comply with its own duty to yield under the first node of this section: it turned across an oncoming vehicle that was within the junction. Having not so yielded, it raises no duty on the other drivers. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (clearCarY k) (-120) (clearCarSpeed k), vanAt k .left .noSignal,
               crossedVehicle k]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k ++ southboundOcc 3 (crossedY k))

    mouth from t = 3950 ms. -/

    every scene from t = 4000 ms, the rotation its yaw rate makes over the interval before it. -/
def vanHeading (k : Nat) : Vec := if k ≤ 79 then Build.north else rotN (k - 79) Build.north

/-- The van's yaw rate: the onset of the turn at t = 4000 ms, held to the end of the trace. -/
def vanYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else degps 30

def vanAt (k : Nat) (ind : TurnIndicatorState) (hand : HandSignal) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (vanPos k) (vanHeading k) (vanSpeed k) (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))

    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (vanYaw k) })

    its nose crosses the junction mouth. -/

    its approach carrier while its rear is north of the junction mouth, the junction while its

def southboundOcc (track : TrackId) (ycm : Int) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  (if ycm ≥ 50 then [(track, 21)] else []) ++

    since it stays far below the turn angle, so it makes no left turn. -/

    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (vanPos k)
        (if k ≤ 79 then Build.north else rotN (min (k - 79) 2) Build.north) (vanSpeed k)

    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (pt (-100) (if k ≤ 70 then 1500 - 20 * (k : Int) else 100))

/-- The junction: a five-metre square where the two streets meet. -/
def junction : Structure := Build.rect 10 .intersection (cm (-250)) (cm (-250)) (cm 250) (cm 250)

/-- The northbound approach: the carrier by which the van reaches the junction. -/
def northboundApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 20 [pt 0 (-10000), pt 250 (-10000), pt 250 (-250), pt 0 (-250)]
    Build.north (enters := some 10)

/-- The southbound approach: the carrier the subject occupies, its direction the opposed one. -/
def southboundApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 21 [pt (-250) 250, pt 0 250, pt 0 10000, pt (-250) 10000]
    Build.south (enters := some 10)

/-- The westbound carrier the van's turn leads into: an approach to no junction here. -/
def westboundExit : Structure :=
  Build.lane 22 [pt (-10000) 0, pt (-250) 0, pt (-250) 250, pt (-10000) 250] Build.west

def roads : List Structure := [junction, northboundApproach, southboundApproach, westboundExit]

/-- A clear, dry afternoon. -/
def weather : Env :=
  { darkness := some false, precipitation := some false, wetRoad := some false,
    iceOrSnow := some false, visibility := some (m 300) }

/-- What the source declares about the van's plan at the junction. -/
def vanIntent (v : Bool) : DeclaredIntent :=
  { vehicle := 2, target := 10,
    values := [("int.turn_left", v), ("int.left_turn", v), ("int.turn_to_the_left", v)] }

/-- The subject car: 4 m by 1.8 m, no yaw, no signal of its own. -/
def car (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals (Build.user 1 [.motorVehicle] pos heading speed (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero, accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The subject in the witness where it is a bicycle, which the aggregate does not include. -/
def cycle (pos : Vec) (heading : Vec) (speed : Q) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals (Build.user 1 [.bicycle] pos heading speed (cm 90, cm 30, cm 90))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun k => { k with yawRate := some Q.zero, accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The van's reference point: north up the approach at 4 m/s to the junction mouth, then one
    metre per second through the turn, then halted inside the junction (or still creeping). -/
def vanPos (k : Nat) (halt : Bool) : Vec :=
  let i : Int := k
  if k ≤ 80 then pt 130 (-2000 + 20 * i)
  else if k ≤ 100 then pt 130 (-400 + 5 * (i - 80))
  else if k ≤ 110 then pt (130 - 2 * (i - 100)) (-300 + 5 * (i - 100))
  else if k ≤ 120 then pt (110 - 4 * (i - 110)) (-250 + 4 * (i - 110))
  else if halt then pt 70 (-210)
  else pt (70 - 4 * (i - 120)) (-210 + 4 * (i - 120))

def vanHeading (k : Nat) : Vec :=
  if k ≤ 100 then Build.north else if k ≤ 110 then nnw else nw

def vanSpeed (k : Nat) (halt : Bool) : Q :=
  if k ≤ 80 then mps 4 else if k ≤ 120 then mps 1 else if halt then Q.zero else mps 1

/-- The van's yaw rate: the turn's onset at t = 4000 ms, held to t = 6000 ms. -/
def vanYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 119 then degps 30 else Q.zero

/-- The yaw rate of a body that bends slightly to the left and makes no left turn: an onset is
    observed, and the heading change accumulated since it stays far below the turn angle. -/
def bendYaw (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 79 then Q.zero else if k ≤ 89 then degps 6 else Q.zero

/-- The van, with the indication it shows and whether it is halted where its turn is recognized. -/
def vanAt (k : Nat) (ind : TurnIndicatorState) (hand : HandSignal) (halt : Bool) : RoadUser :=
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (vanPos k halt) (vanHeading k) (vanSpeed k halt)
        (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some ind, handSignal := some hand }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (vanYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

/-- The van's stated occupancy: its approach carrier throughout, and the junction from the moment
    its nose crosses the junction mouth. -/
def vanOcc (k : Nat) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  if k ≤ 75 then [(2, 20)] else [(2, 20), (2, 10)]

/-- A southbound body's stated occupancy, from the height of its reference point (centimetres):
    its approach carrier while its rear is north of the junction mouth, the junction while its
    nose is south of it. -/
def southboundOcc (track : TrackId) (ycm : Int) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  (if ycm ≥ 50 then [(track, 21)] else []) ++
  (if ycm ≤ 450 then (if ycm ≥ -450 then [(track, 10)] else []) else [])

/-- The vehicle that runs north through the junction with a slight bend, making no left turn. -/
def straightVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let i : Int := k
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 2 [.motorVehicle] (pt 130 (-2000 + 20 * i)) Build.north (mps 4)
        (cm 240, m 1, cm 95))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (bendYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

def straightOcc (k : Nat) : List (TrackId × RegionId) :=
  let y : Int := -2000 + 20 * (k : Int)
  (if y ≤ -10 then [(2, 20)] else []) ++
  (if y ≥ -490 then (if y ≤ 490 then [(2, 10)] else []) else [])

/-- A car that came south down the approach and stopped inside the junction, where the van's
    turn crosses it. -/
def crossedVehicle (k : Nat) : RoadUser :=
  let i : Int := k
  Build.withKin
    (Build.withSignals
      (Build.user 3 [.motorVehicle] (pt (-100) (if k ≤ 92 then 2000 - 20 * i else 160))
        Build.south (if k ≤ 92 then mps 4 else Q.zero) (m 2, cm 90, cm 75))
      (fun s => { s with turnIndicator := some .off, handSignal := some .noSignal }))
    (fun kk => { kk with yawRate := some (bendYaw k), accelLongitudinal := some Q.zero })

def crossedY (k : Nat) : Int := if k ≤ 92 then 2000 - 20 * (k : Int) else 160

/-- A scene of a witness: the bodies, the roads, the stated occupancy and the declarations. -/
def sceneOf (t : Timestamp) (users : List RoadUser) (occ : List (TrackId × RegionId))
    (intents : List DeclaredIntent) : Scene :=
  Build.scene t (some 1) users roads [] (some occ) weather [] intents

/-- 141 scenes at the acquisition profile's 50 ms, t = 0 to 7000 ms. -/
def traceOf (f : Nat → Timestamp → Scene) : Trace := Build.trace 141 0 (Units.milliseconds 50) f

/-- The subject braking well short of the junction: 4 m/s, then one metre per second. -/
def clearCarY (k : Nat) : Int :=
  let i : Int := k
  if k ≤ 90 then 3400 - 20 * i else 1600 - 5 * (i - 90)
def clearCarSpeed (k : Nat) : Q := if k ≤ 90 then mps 4 else mps 1

/-- `forbid` (violated): A van within a junction has yielded to the opposing stream, shows its left indicator through the two seconds before its turn is recognized, and turns left. The subject car occupies the opposing approach lane entering the same junction and drives on into the van's path, the two bodies touching. -/
def forbidTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 3400 - 25 * (k : Int)
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-100) y) Build.south (mps 5), vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `permit` (compliant): The same junction and the same signalled, yielded left turn by the van. The subject car brakes on its approach and stays more than ten metres clear of the van throughout, no closest approach within the horizon coming near the clearance bound. -/
def permitTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k),
               vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `idle` (not_applicable): The subject car occupies the opposing approach lane of a junction in which no vehicle is making a left turn at all: no road user raises the duty, so the rule is not engaged. -/
def idleTrace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k), straightVehicle k]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ straightOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `blind` (unknown): A van makes a signalled left turn in the junction the subject approaches, but the source does not report whether the van's footprint overlaps the junction region, so whether the turn is the one made in that intersection is unknown. -/
def blindTrace : Trace := permitTrace

/-- `branch_1` (not_applicable): The van turns left in the junction and has yielded to the opposing stream, but its indicator stays off and it gives no arm signal in the window behind the recognition of the turn: the weaker fact -- a turn made without the signal the words require -- leaves the other drivers' duty unraised, and the rule is not engaged. -/
def branch_1Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k),
               vanAt k .off .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `branch_2` (not_applicable): The van signals left and turns, but it did not comply with its own duty to yield under the first node of this section: it turned across an oncoming vehicle that was within the junction. Having not so yielded, it raises no duty on the other drivers. -/
def branch_2Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) (clearCarY k)) Build.south (clearCarSpeed k),
               vanAt k .left .noSignal false, crossedVehicle k]
      (southboundOcc 1 (clearCarY k) ++ vanOcc k ++ southboundOcc 3 (crossedY k))
      [vanIntent true]

/-- `branch_3` (compliant): The van gives no indicator but signals the turn with its arm, and
    turns. The subject car has stopped on its approach well short of the junction: standing, it
    grants precedence. -/
def branch_3Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := if k ≤ 100 then 2600 - 20 * (k : Int) else 600
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-120) y) Build.south (if k ≤ 100 then mps 4 else Q.zero),
               vanAt k .off .left true]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `branch_4` (violated): The same signalled turn, the van halted in the junction. The subject
    car holds 8 m/s down its approach, twenty metres short: the bodies are far apart, but the
    closest approach their velocities predict within the horizon is under two metres. -/
def branch_4Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 6800 - 40 * (k : Int)
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-100) y) Build.south (mps 8), vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `branch_5` (violated): The same signalled turn. The subject car creeps on past the halted van
    and ends up less than a metre from its flank without touching it: their centres do not
    approach within the horizon, and the gap between the nearest points of the two bodies is
    below the clearance. -/
def branch_5Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let i : Int := k
    let y : Int := if k ≤ 119 then 1450 - 10 * i else 250 - 2 * (i - 120)
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-200) y) Build.south (if k ≤ 119 then mps 2 else Units.micrometresPerSecond 400000),
               vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `branch_6` (compliant): The same signalled turn. The subject car comes down the far side of
    its approach at 4 m/s: the centres do approach within the horizon, and the closest approach
    stays above the clearance, as does the gap between the bodies. -/
def branch_6Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 3350 - 20 * (k : Int)
    sceneOf t [car (pt (-200) y) Build.south (mps 4), vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      (southboundOcc 1 y ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

/-- `branch_7` (not_applicable): The road user on the opposing approach is a bicycle, which the
    aggregate of DEF-NRS-484A-320 does not include: the subject of this duty is a vehicle, so the
    rule is not engaged. -/
def branch_7Trace : Trace :=
  traceOf fun k t =>
    let y : Int := 2000 - 10 * (k : Int)
    sceneOf t [cycle (pt (-120) y) Build.south (mps 2), vanAt k .left .noSignal true]
      ([(1, 21)] ++ vanOcc k) [vanIntent false]

def witness (name : String) (τ : Trace) (expected : Verdict)
    (absent : List String := []) (boundary : String := "")
    (window : Option (Timestamp × Timestamp) := some (6000, 7000)) : Scenario :=
  { name := name
    rule := "NRS_484B_253_o2"
    trace := τ
    reading := {}          -- ignored by the gate: the run's reading is substituted
    manifest := Build.manifest absent
    grounding := [("v", 1)]
    expected := expected
    window := window
    boundary := boundary }

def scenarios : List Scenario :=
  [ witness "forbid" forbidTrace .violated
  , witness "permit" permitTrace .compliant
  , witness "idle" idleTrace .notApplicable
  , witness "blind" blindTrace (.unknown []) ["rel.occupies"]
  , witness "branch_1" branch_1Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_2" branch_2Trace .notApplicable
  , witness "branch_3" branch_3Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_4" branch_4Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_5" branch_5Trace .violated
  , witness "branch_6" branch_6Trace .compliant
  , witness "branch_7" branch_7Trace .notApplicable ]

end TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_253_o2

  operationalization and composition below is written, and every choice the text did not dictate).

    c1 (condition): but such driver, having so yielded
    c2 (condition): and having given a signal when and as required,
    c3 (condition): may make such left turn
    s1 (subject): and the drivers of all other vehicles approaching the intersection from the opposite direction
    ob1 (obligation): shall yield the right-of-way to the vehicle making the left turn.

    c3: atoms ['rel.occupies', 'st.intersection'], derived ['drv.motion.left_turn']
    s1: atoms ['ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle', 'rel.occupies', 'st.travel_region', 'st.lane_enters', 'st.lane_direction', 'st.intersection'], derived []

  `ru_aggregate` with the aggregate id. "all other vehicles" is `.not (.same t v)` against the
  road user the duty is owed to. "approaching the intersection from the opposite direction" is the
  ontology's own reading: a carrier `cv` of kind `st.travel_region` that `v` occupies
  (`rel_occupies`) whose entrance end is the junction `j` (`st_lane_enters`), with that carrier's
  designated direction (`st_lane_direction`, read by component) opposed to the direction of the
  carrier `ct` by which the turning vehicle reached `j` — their dot product at or below the
  negative of `p.same_direction_cosine_tolerance`. Both quantifiers range over `travel_region` as

  recognition, through `atLast` over the same window, and the "some observation in the window
  behind it" is `.not (.holdsFor … (.not …))`. Consequence, stated here because the language

import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule

namespace TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B_253_o2

/-- The binders, as arguments (order and names are the node's). -/
def vV : Arg := .var "v"

/-- The road user the duty is owed to, and the regions the formulas quantify over. -/
def tV : Arg := .var "t"
def jV : Arg := .var "j"
def cvV : Arg := .var "cv"
def ctV : Arg := .var "ct"

/-- The admitted aggregate of the node's class element, by its id. -/
def aggVehicle : Arg := .lit "DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"

/-- The reading's parameters; no value of any of them lives in this file. -/
def pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph : Term := .param "p.heading_since_step_carla_scene_graph"
def pLeftTurnAngle : Term := .param "p.left_turn_angle"
def pSameDirectionCosineTolerance : Term := .param "p.same_direction_cosine_tolerance"
def pTurnOnsetYawRate : Term := .param "p.turn_onset_yaw_rate"
def pTurnSignalAdvanceWindow : Term := .param "p.turn_signal_advance_window"
def pYieldConflictHorizon : Term := .param "p.yield_conflict_horizon"
def pYieldMinClearance : Term := .param "p.yield_min_clearance"

def zeroMetres : Term := .lit Q.zero .metre
def zeroSpeed : Term := .lit Q.zero .metrePerSecond

/-- Class of `v`: ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle -/
def clsV : Formula := .atom "ru_aggregate" [vV, aggVehicle] []

/-- c3: the turning vehicle has turned to the left, by the concept of the catalogue. -/
def leftTurnMade : Formula :=
  .derived "drv_motion_left_turn" [tV]
    [pHeadingSinceStepCarlaSceneGraph, pTurnOnsetYawRate, pLeftTurnAngle]

/-- c3: that turn is the one made in the junction `j`, whose region the vehicle's footprint
    overlaps. -/
def turnsLeftInJunction : Formula :=
  .and (.atom "st_intersection" [jV] [])
    (.and (.atom "rel_occupies" [tV, jV] []) leftTurnMade)

/-- c2: a left indication, by the turn indicator or by the arm. -/
def leftIndication : Formula :=
  .or (.atom "sig_turn_indicator" [tV, .lit "left"] [])
      (.atom "sig_hand_signal" [tV, .lit "left"] [])

/-- c2: the signal given when and as required — a left indication at some observation in the
    window `p.turn_signal_advance_window` behind the recognition of the turn. -/

/-
  Witnesses for NRS_484B_253_o2.

  THE GEOMETRY. One junction, a five-metre square at the origin (region 10), where a north-south
  street meets an east-west street. Region 20 is the northbound approach (x from 0 to 2.5 m, south
  of the junction), its designated direction north, its entrance end that junction; region 21 is
  the southbound approach (x from -2.5 to 0 m, north of the junction), its direction south, its
  entrance end the same junction; region 22 is the westbound carrier the van's turn leads into,
  which is an approach to no junction here.

  THE BODIES. Track 1 is the subject, a car 4 m by 1.8 m coming south down region 21 (in one
  witness a bicycle instead). Track 2 is the van, 4.8 m by 2 m, which comes north up region 20 at
  4 m/s, stands from t = 3950 ms with its reference point at (1.3, -1.8) m — in the junction
  mouth, its footprint overlapping both its approach carrier and the junction throughout — and
  from t = 4000 ms swings to the left at 30 deg/s: one and a half degrees between consecutive
  scenes, written as an exact rational rotation of its heading, so that heading and yaw rate say
  the same thing at every scene. The heading change accumulated since that onset passes
  forty-five degrees at t = 5500 ms, where its left turn is recognized, and reaches ninety
  degrees by the end. Track 3, where a witness has one, is a car that came south down region 21
  and stopped in the junction, across the van's turn.

  Every body here either stands or runs straight at a constant speed, its position advancing by
  the speed of the scene over the interval before it, so that no scene asserts a motion its own
  figures deny.

  THE INSTANTS. Every trace is 141 scenes at 50 ms, t = 0 to 7000 ms — the sampling period of the
  run's acquisition profile, so the concept's integration is never short of a sample, and long
  enough that every three-second window behind a judged instant is covered. Each witness names
  the instants it speaks about, t = 6000 to 7000 ms: the second and a half after the turn is
  recognized. Before the yaw onset the turn concept is unknown, as its contract says: no onset is
  observed yet.

import TrafficSpec.Rules.NRS_484B.NRS_484B_253_o2
import TrafficSpec.Core.Evidence.Builders

namespace TrafficSpecWitness.NRS_484B_253_o2

open TrafficSpec

def m (n : Int) : Q := Units.metres n
def cm (n : Int) : Q := Units.centimetres n
def mps (n : Int) : Q := Units.metresPerSecond n
def degps (n : Int) : Q := Units.degrees n
/-- A point of the world frame, in centimetres: every coordinate below is exact. -/

/-- The rotation to the left by one step of the van's turn: the one and a half degrees its yaw
    rate of 30 deg/s makes over the 50 ms before a scene, as an exact rational rotation. -/
def stepCos : Q := Units.ratio 9996573 10000000
def stepSin : Q := Units.ratio 261769 10000000

/-- Keep a coordinate to a tenth of a micrometre, so the sixty steps of the turn stay small
    exact rationals; the angle between consecutive headings is unaffected at this resolution. -/
def trim (q : Q) : Q := Units.ratio ((q.num * 10000000) / Int.ofNat q.den) 10000000

def rotLeft (v : Vec) : Vec :=
  (trim (Q.sub (Q.mul v.1 stepCos) (Q.mul v.2 stepSin)),
   trim (Q.add (Q.mul v.1 stepSin) (Q.mul v.2 stepCos)))

/-- `n` steps of that rotation. -/
def rotN : Nat → Vec → Vec
  | 0, v => v
  | n + 1, v => rotLeft (rotN n v)

/-- The junction: a five-metre square where the two streets meet. -/

def northboundApproach : Structure :=
  Build.lane 20 [pt 0 (-10000), pt 250 (-10000), pt 250 (-250), pt 0 (-250)]

/-- The southbound approach: the carrier the subject occupies, its direction the opposed one. -/
